title: Implementation Consultant
description:
About Crisis24
  
Crisis24 is a global, AI-enhanced provider of travel risk management, mass communications, critical event management, crisis-security consulting, personal protection solutions and global medical concierge capabilities, allowing prominent organizations, disruptive brands and influential people to operate with confidence in an uncertain world. Backed by proprietary AI-enabled SaaS technologies, advanced Global Operations Centers, an extensive global footprint, and the largest team of private-sector intelligence analysts in the world, we deliver localized insights and global perspectives alongside medical, security, crisis response, embedded intelligence, and consultancy services as a preferred partner for Fortune 500 corporations.
  
At Crisis24, we don't just offer jobs – we offer missions. We recruit the very best from the military, intelligence agencies, academia, law enforcement, medicine, or any of our areas of specialty. We protect more than places. We protect people, reputations, and lifestyles, with integrity, discipline, discretion, and purpose. Whether you're stepping into civilian life after service, seeking personal or professional growth, or bringing specialized expertise to a higher calling, we match your ambition with real opportunity. Do the most important work of your career, helping safeguard the world's most important organizations and individuals against risk.
  
More information is available at https://www.crisis24.com/careers
  
  
Who We Are Looking For
  
  
The Implementation Consultant leads multiple complex SaaS upgrades simultaneously from client kickoff through go-live on the new platform, including configuration, data migration, training, and rollout. This customer-focused, process-driven role guides clients through implementation, offers best practices, aligns solutions to customer goals and success criteria, and helps ensure long-term satisfaction and retention. Implementation Consultants also act as trusted advisors and help mentor and onboard newer team members.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Lead complex SaaS implementations and migrations from kickoff through successful deployment, ensuring clear timelines, milestones, deliverables, and customer expectations.
* Diligently track project activity, customer communication, risks, configuration details, and issue resolution using project management and internal tracking tools.
* Build strong client relationships by understanding business use cases, success criteria, configuration needs, and desired outcomes.
* Lead special initiatives to improve the customer experience by addressing upgrade process gaps, supporting CSAT actions, and accelerating the customer upgrade journey.
* Understand and translate customer needs, identify upgrade and distinguishing business outcomes from feature requests.
* Provide best-practice guidance, training, and recommendations that help customers optimize platform usage and align the solution to their goals.
* Drive customer success by using client feedback and CSAT survey results to improve the implementation experience and support long-term satisfaction and retention.
* Coordinate with your leader to resolve issues, manage handoffs, and support long-term client success.
* Share client feedback with internal teams to improve processes, documentation, product functionality, and the overall implementation experience.
* Mentor Implementation Specialists by helping with customer communications, unfamiliar configurations, process questions, and implementation best practices.
* May be assigned other duties as needed.

Qualifications
  
  

* 5+ years of progressive, client-facing experience in implementation, customer success, customer upgrades, migrations, onboarding, or a related SaaS role.
* Strong consultative communication skills, with the ability to set expectations, translate customer needs into clear requirements, explain technical concepts, and advise technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage multiple customer projects, timelines, risks, blockers, and competing priorities while keeping upgrades moving toward successful go-live.
* Process-driven, customer-focused mindset with the ability to use project tracking, CRM, feedback, and internal collaboration tools to support customer outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, ITIL, or similar.
* Client-facing SaaS experience supporting implementations, migrations, training, complex configurations, or legacy-to-new-platform transitions.
* Experience mentoring peers or supporting new team members through implementation processes and customer-facing work.
* Proficiency in French and/or German and/or Spanish is advantageous

**Working Conditions:**  

* Hybrid or remote work environment.
* May require occasional travel to meet with customer or attend company events.

Information Security
  
  

* Protect the data and systems of Crisis24 and its stakeholders by adhering to policies, reporting incidents and potential problems, completing regular training, and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Crisis24 is dedicated to equal opportunity in employment. We are committed to a work environment that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate against any individual based on race, color, sex, national origin, age, religion, marital or parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any factors protected by applicable laws.

**Position:** Commercial Operations Analyst

**Location:** Cape Town, South Africa, Onsite

Watchmaker Genomics is a global life science company based in Boulder, Colorado, with an R&D and Production facility in Cape Town, South Africa. Our team is passionate about innovation and values collaboration, creativity, and scientific rigor.

We believe that the intersection of biology, engineering, and computer science presents exciting opportunities for developing novel technologies that promote research and improve human health. Watchmaker Genomics specializes in the design, development, and production of DNA- and RNA-modifying enzymes that enable high-growth applications in genomics, molecular diagnostics, and personalized medicine.

**Position Summary**

Watchmaker Genomics is inviting applications for the full-time position of **Commercial Operations Analyst**, based in Cape Town, South Africa (onsite).

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and plays a key role in optimizing commercial operations. In this role, the analyst will be part of the team that designs, implements and continuous improvements to our commercial software platforms (SFDC, Hubspot, Epicor). This position will also work closely with IT and Finance to support the design, roll-out, and maintenance of new sales and marketing analytics tools, enabling more data-driven decision-making across the commercial organization.

**Responsibilities**

* **Process Ownership and Education:** Develop, document and deliver training on commercial and reporting processes. Create and maintain standard operating procedures and training materials. Assist commercial platform owners with ongoing commercial systems training and user adoption.
* **Salesforce Stewardship:** Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the Salesforce CRM sales module to ensure successful rollout and adoption across the commercial team. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and forecasting tools to track key performance metrics across the commercial organization.
* **Requirement Gathering & Roadmap**: Gather, document and prioritize reporting requirements from business stakeholders (sales, marketing, support). Continuously identify ways to improve and advance our current reporting capabilities.
* **Customer Master Data Validation:** Ensure data integrity and reliability across related commercial systems (SFDC, Epicor, PowerBI Connection), implementing best practices for data management.
* **Field Reporting Support:** Troubleshoot Salesforce and analytics-related issues, coordinating with internal stakeholders to resolve problems quickly. Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and enhanced reporting capabilities.
* **Commercial Administration:** Develop and execute key quarterly and annual tasks including commission calculations and customer notifications.
* **Commercial Project Management:** Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including Marketing, Product Management, and Technical Support, to align analytics and CRM functionality with business needs.

**Skills and Requirements**

The candidate should have a bachelor's degree with at least 5 years of experience in sales operations, commercial analytics, or related roles. Experience in biotech, life sciences, and start-up environments is highly desirable.

The following skills and experience are requirements for the position:

* Strong experience with Salesforce CRM (administration, customization, or reporting).
* Proficiency with analytics and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and comfort working with large datasets.
* Proven ability to develop actionable reporting and insights for business leaders.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, and process improvement skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work across multiple teams.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or related field required.
* 5 years of experience in sales operations, CRM product ownership, or commercial analytics.

title: Workforce Manager
description:
Req ID#: 420282

Cape Town, South Africa, ZA, Foundever

Job Description:

**Mission**
-----------

The WFM Shared Services Manager is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for the operational performance, people leadership, and WFM strategy execution of the Foundever EMEA Shared Services Hub. Sitting above site-level WFM management, this role holds full accountability for the delivery of Real-Time Management and Scheduling functions across all accounts and business units supported by the hub.

  

This role serves as the central WFM authority for the Shared Services location, managing a layered team of WFM Leads (Scheduling and Real-Time, Local and Global) and their Analyst teams, driving consistent operational standards, and championing EMEA WFM strategy at hub level. The WFM Shared Services Manager is the primary WFM leadership contact for internal stakeholders, client partners, and new business onboarding across the region.

  

With full ownership of the WFM function — including financial performance, efficiency optimization, workforce strategy, and team development — this role ensures the hub operates as a cohesive, high-performing, and commercially accountable WFM centre of excellence across all supported EMEA accounts.

**About the Job**
-----------------

The WFM Shared Services Manager operates within a high-complexity, multi-account, multi-geography environment, blending strategic oversight with hands-on people management. The role manages a layered team structure covering Real-Time and Scheduling disciplines, at both local and global level, and ensures the hub functions as a unified, high-performing operation across all supported EMEA accounts.

  

This role requires the ability to operate simultaneously at both a strategic leadership level and an operational execution level — driving EMEA WFM strategy through the team while maintaining direct oversight of intraday delivery quality, scheduling governance, financial performance, and stakeholder relationships. The WFM Shared Services Manager is responsible for the commercial health of the WFM function, including P&L management, cost efficiency, and contribution to margin optimization targets.

  

As a senior people leader and WFM subject matter expert, this role shapes the culture, capability, and performance of the hub's WFM community, building long-term talent pipelines and embedding best practices that raise the standard of WFM delivery across Foundever EMEA.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Hub Leadership and People Management**
----------------------------------------

* Lead, develop, and performance manage WFM Leads (Scheduling and Real-Time, Local and Global) and their Analyst teams across the EMEA Shared Services Hub.
* Set team objectives, individual development plans, and performance goals aligned to the EMEA WFM strategy and hub operational priorities.
* Foster a high-performance, accountability-driven culture across the full hub WFM team.
* Build structured career pathways and deliver targeted training programs for WFM professionals across Real-Time, Scheduling, and Reporting disciplines.
* Lead talent acquisition, onboarding, and knowledge transfer for new hub team members, ensuring rapid competency and integration.
* Conduct structured performance reviews, one-to-one sessions, and succession planning discussions for all direct and indirect reports.
* Act as the escalation point for people management challenges within the hub WFM team.

**EMEA WFM Strategy and Governance**
------------------------------------

* Translate and execute the EMEA WFM strategy at hub level across Real-Time Management and Scheduling functions.
* Define, implement, and enforce WFM standard operating procedures, best practices, and governance frameworks across all hub accounts.
* Own WFM governance — conducting operational audits, compliance reviews, and quality assurance checks across the team.
* Act as the WFM subject matter expert in senior leadership discussions, business reviews, client governance forums, and strategic planning sessions.
* Develop and maintain Business Continuity Plans for all hub-supported accounts, ensuring WFM operational resilience.
* Champion continuous improvement across scheduling efficiency, real-time responsiveness, and shrinkage management at hub level.

**Financial Performance and WFM P&L Ownership**
-----------------------------------------------

* Hold full accountability for the WFM function P&L within the Shared Services Hub, including cost management, resource efficiency, and margin contribution.
* Manage WFM costing, staffing ratios, and commercial levers to ensure the WFM function operates within budget and delivers measurable value to the business.
* Partner with Finance and the Head of Shared Services EMEA on headcount planning, cost forecasting, and scenario modeling tied to financial targets.
* Drive efficiency initiatives that reduce shrinkage, optimize occupancy, improve bill-to-pay ratios, and enhance billable hours performance without compromising customer experience.
* Provide regular financial performance reporting on WFM function costs, efficiency metrics, and commercial outcomes to senior leadership.
* Contribute WFM financial insight and workforce cost modeling to new business proposals, client renewals, and commercial planning processes.
* Identify and implement cost optimization opportunities within the scheduling and real-time functions that protect margin without degrading service quality.
* Ensure all financial reporting related to the WFM function is accurate, timely, and aligned with organizational reporting standards.

**WFM Efficiency and Optimization**
-----------------------------------

* Own the hub WFM optimization roadmap, identifying structural inefficiencies across scheduling, real-time, and reporting processes and driving measurable improvements.
* Lead automation initiatives within scheduling workflows, real-time monitoring, and reporting, partnering with technology teams on system enhancements, integrations, and platform upgrades.
* Benchmark hub WFM performance against industry standards and internal Foundever targets, using data to drive performance improvement decisions.
* Standardize WFM execution frameworks across all hub accounts to ensure consistency, quality, and operational scalability.
* Evaluate and recommend new WFM tools, platforms, and technologies that enhance hub capability and deliver competitive advantage.
* Drive a data-led culture within the hub WFM team, ensuring all decisions — from schedule generation to intraday actions — are grounded in accurate analysis and evidence.
* Implement tooling improvements that reduce manual effort, increase scheduling accuracy, and enhance real-time responsiveness across the team.

**Account Portfolio Management**
--------------------------------

* Maintain full WFM operational oversight across all hub-supported EMEA accounts, ensuring each is staffed appropriately and performing to SLA and KPI targets.
* Monitor account-level performance trends, identifying risks, variances, and improvement opportunities before they impact service delivery.
* Ensure each account is supported by appropriately resourced, skilled, and well-directed WFM teams under clear management accountability.

opportunities,

title: Director: Growth Marketing
description:
### **Description**

**The Role**  
  
We are hiring a Director: Growth Marketing to own one number: **the velocity of our high-margin enterprise pipeline**. You will report directly to our CEO who acts as CMO and carries the category voice and partner closely with our Head of Product Marketing, who owns positioning and messaging. Your job is the engine: making enterprise deals start warmer, move faster and close more often, and building the AI-native marketing operating system that lets a small team punch far above its headcount.

This is not a brand-custodian role and it is not an MQL factory. It is a builder’s role for an operator who has personally moved win rates and cycle times, builds workflows with their own hands, and wants the leverage of a category-defining platform with 25 years of enterprise proof behind it.

### **Responsibilities**

  

* **Enterprise pipeline velocity.** Baseline stage conversion, cycle time and win rate on our ideal-customer-profile deals (banking, insurance, retail, telco) within 30 days then move them, measurably, on marketing-touched deals.
* **A named-account engine, co-owned with Sales.** A golden list of target accounts, intent and trigger signals (regulatory deadlines, channel launches, contact-centre RFPs), and plays by deal stage account-based marketing measured on stage progression, never on engagement theatre.
* **Deal-acceleration content, with Product Marketing**. Business cases and ROI tools, security and compliance packs for regulated buyers, reference programmes, and competitive kits against the AI-native field.
* **Founder and executive amplification**. Run the content system that makes our CEO and leadership the visible voice of Agentic Commerce on LinkedIn, on stage, and in the executive communities where enterprise buyers actually decide.
* **An AI-native marketing operating system**. AI-assisted content production, enrichment and personalisation workflows, GTM-engineering leverage, and CRM hygiene in service of velocity reporting built so three people do the work of fifteen.
* **Product-led growth integration**. Our self-serve motion launches in late 2026. With Product, you will define product-qualified leads, the self-serve-to-sales handoff, and the expansion signals that feed the enterprise pipeline.
* **Credibility levers for regulated buyers.** Analyst briefings, customer proof at scale, and executive events that shorten risk review and make procurement easier to say yes to.

  

### **Requirements**

  

* Highly experienced in B2B growth, demand or revenue marketing, including solid experience leading a function in **enterprise SaaS or AI** with evidence you moved win rate or cycle time, not just lead volume.
* Hands-on command of the modern go-to-market stack: CRM, data enrichment, AI agents, attribution. You can build the workflow yourself before you hire for it.
* Narrative fluency: you can take a category story and turn it into stage-specific assets, campaigns and moments without needing to invent the category yourself.
* Working fluency in product-led growth: activation, product-qualified leads, usage signals, and the handoff to sales.
* The temperament to operate under a founder CEO who holds the brand pen, and alongside a Product Marketing peer whose work you strengthen rather than duplicate.
* Based in South Africa

**How We Will Measure You**

* Pipeline velocity on ideal-customer-profile enterprise deals the headline number
* Stage-to-stage conversion rates
* Median cycle time on marketing-touched versus untouched deals
* Win rate and average deal value on marketing-touched deals
* Marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced qualified pipeline (opportunity-based)
* Product-qualified-lead-to-opportunity conversion once self-serve launches
* ***We do not measure MQLs.***

**How You Will Work**

* **Velocity owner.** You treat the pipeline velocity equation as your P&L and isolate marketing’s effect honestly.
* **AI-native builder.** Small team, maximum leverage: you automate the repeatable and spend human time on the moments that compound.
* **Trusted amplifier.** You make our leaders and our customers the story not the marketing department.
* **Straight talker.** You bring the number, name the risk, and hold a position under pressure.

  

### **Benefits**

Working with a world-class, award-winning, international team with strong values and a meaningful ambition. You can expect work that will stretch you, grow you, and allow you to shape products and experiences that matter. We are building with intent, learning continuously, and creating real impact.

Other benefits include:

o Medical Aid contribution

o Pension fund contribution

o Quarterly performance incentive bonus

o Risk benefit company contributions

o Reimbursable communications allowance for internet and mobile phone bills

o Half-day off on your birthday

o 5 personal days leave a year, over and above your annual leave + ½ day off on your birthday

o Flexible working conditions (remote & in person) with access to office hubs as required \**current policy*

o Home office set-up with laptop, monitor and other related items.

### **About Clickatell**

**Clickatell**, founded in **Cape Town in 2000**, was the **first company to connect businesses with consumers via SMS** using just four lines of code. Today, it powers **AI-driven chat commerce** for leading global brands across industries like **banking, retail, telecoms, and healthcare**. Over **25 years**, Clickatell has led multiple industry firsts through its **award-winning AI Chat Commerce Platform**, enabling brands to connect, interact, and transact with customers seamlessly.

By applying for this position, you consent to Clickatell collecting and processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with POPIA and GDPR. Your information will be retained for 12 months. For enquiries, contact **privacy@clickatell.com**.

title: Data Analyst
description:
* Written by: Paul Geary

Join the movement.

### **Job description**

One Custom is looking for the best minds to join our team. If you love data, have a natural curiosity about what drives human behaviour, and get excited about interpreting data into practical conclusions, this job is ideal for you.

Our aim is to help our partners deliver on our “good for people, good for business” vision. For this role, that means you’ll need to be the driver of better customer/business understanding through analysis/insights and data visualisation. Understanding a client’s business is paramount. Getting your hands dirty with the application of that understanding (w.r.t. data analysis) is the natural next step and crucial to the role. Teamwork and collaboration are essential. Challenging one another or asking the hard questions is always encouraged.

The candidate we choose will be a junior to mid-weight analyst, someone with a few years experience, who understands our vision and is keen to help grow our offering and prepared to punch above their current weight. You’ll need to have some good analytics experience and a portfolio that backs it up.

  

### **Requirements:**

* Analyse and present data in a way that provides actionable insights, by presenting findings in a practical and interpretable way for the business.
* Identify key trends in large datasets and engage with business to understand the impact of these trends and help identify actions to respond to the identified trends.
* Identify appropriate models / algorithms to mine datasets and develop rich insights into customer behaviour.
* Experience in developing and implementing predictive models.
* Build analytics assets and processes to ensure repeatable results and enabling automation and reuse.
* A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field like business, marketing, finance, or statistics.
* 2+ years experience in data crunching.
* Strong knowledge of data analysis and data visualization tools such as SQL, Python/R, MS Power BI.
* Be a self-starter, a creative problem solver, strategic, and has the ability to multitask, prioritize, and scale.

### **Advantageous:**

* Experience in digital marketing and/or eCommerce
* Experience with CRM software (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics)

### **Personal Skills/Attributes:**

* Logical thinker and problem solver
* Fanatical attention to detail
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritise critical project milestones
* Comfortable presenting data and insights internally and to clients

title: Data Scientist I
description:
**Data Scientist I**

**About the job**

The purpose of the Data Scientist I role is to support the data science team in transforming and modelling data to generate insights that contribute to business objectives and strengthen data as a competitive advantage for Shoprite. Working under guidance, the role extracts, analyses and interprets data from a range of sources using data mining, artificial intelligence, machine learning and statistical techniques to identify trends and patterns. The role develops foundational technical, analytical and communication skills to interpret data and present findings as a clear and cohesive story.

**What you'll do**

* Under the guidance of the Data Scientist Lead or Team Lead, work with business stakeholders to identify requirements and frame meaningful business scenarios that answer relevant business questions.
* Work closely with data and software teams to translate business requirements into fit-for-purpose, robust and scalable solutions.
* Develop, validate and execute basic algorithms and predictive models to collect, merge, analyse, extract and interpret large datasets.
* Use data to investigate problems, detect patterns and extrapolate insights.
* Develop data structures and pipelines to organise, collect and standardise data.
* Perform data preparation in order to reduce and shape data. Clean and validate data and assure its integrity, accuracy, completeness, and uniformity.
* Test data mining models to select the most appropriate one for use on a project.
* Adhere to stringent quality assurance and documentation standards using version control and code repositories.
* Cross-validate models to ensure their generalizability.
* Assess the effectiveness of data sources and data-gathering techniques to improve data collection methods.
* Prepare analytical findings, results and reports using data visualisation techniques.
* Effectively structure and plan projects, timelines, and deliverables, working with the Data Scientist Lead / Team Lead to weigh any business and technical trade-offs.
* Conduct research from which to develop prototypes and proof of concepts.
* Share insights across teams to inform collaborative efforts.
* Stay updated on the latest research and developments in Data Science and adjacent fields to ensure the latest technology, techniques and methods are always applied.

**What you bring**

* Degree or Diploma in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related field – (essential).
* 2–4 years' experience in a Data Scientist or similar role, with exposure to applying machine learning, deep learning, data mining and mathematical and/or statistical methods to support business objectives – (essential).
* Basic knowledge of SQL, Python and data science toolkits – (essential).
* Proficiency in MS Office 365 with well-developed Excel skills – (essential).
* Exposure to delivering project outcomes using design thinking, lean and agile principles – (desired).
* Experience in a retail, commercial or IT environment – (desired).

**Key competencies and work ethic**

* An emerging data specialist with a passion for practicing the art of Data Science. Solves data problems using their knowledge in scientific disciplines.
* Analytical and highly numerate – Able to collect, organise and assimilate disparate and multiple pieces of data to draw sound conclusions and arrive at optimal solutions.
* Technical aptitude with a passion and excitement for data, new technologies and solutions and its range of possibilities, applications and value for the business.
* High level of self-motivation and drive to meet and exceed on goals and expectations. Able to work independently and use own initiative to deal with challenges in areas of familiarity.

We work with cutting-edge cloud platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and Azure Synapse, and we're proud of our culture of continuous learning, internal training, and technical excellence.

**The Role**

We are recruiting an exceptional Analytics Engineer for a high-impact engagement with a leading global private equity and investment advisory firm in Cape Town. You will sit between the business and our client's data platform, turning how their investment, finance, and portfolio teams think about performance into governed, trusted, well-modelled data that is ready to use in BI tools.

Design, build and own the semantic layer, with consistent metric definitions, dimensions and business logic that BI tools consume. Develop and maintain transformation pipelines and data models in dbt on Snowflake, following software engineering best practice (testing, documentation, version control, CI/CD). Translate financial and portfolio concepts, such as charts of accounts, fund and entity structures, KPIs, valuations and cash flows, into clean, reconcilable data models.

**BI Product Development**  
Build and optimise reports and dashboards in Sigma, working to a "model once, use everywhere" principle. Standardise and harmonise data across a broad portfolio of assets and source systems. Own the data quality, documentation and ongoing support of the BI products you deliver.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Domain Expertise**  
Work directly with business stakeholders (investment professionals, finance, portfolio operations) to understand their requirements, challenge assumptions constructively, and translate them into data requirements and technical delivery on the client's data platform. Communicate technical solutions clearly to non-technical audiences and drive data stewardship and knowledge sharing across teams.

* 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, BI development or related fields.

Location - Town or City

Brackenfell

IT

  

About the role

As an **Integration Architect**, you’ll provide strategic architecture leadership, integration governance and design assurance across the **TRANS4M programme** and the broader SAP and non-SAP technology landscape.

Operating as the **TRANS4M Integration Stream Lead**, you’ll help shape how integration solutions are designed and delivered, ensuring they are secure, scalable, resilient, supportable and aligned with Shoprite’s target-state architecture.

You’ll define integration standards and reusable patterns, govern solution designs and architecture decisions, and provide practical guidance to programme teams, architects, engineers and delivery partners. The integration landscape spans **SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP Integration Suite, SAP PO, SAP Data Services, SAP SuccessFactors, APIs, managed file transfer solutions**, and a range of business-critical SAP and non-SAP applications supporting Finance, Retail Operations, Supply Chain, Customer, HR, reporting and third-party services.

A key focus of the role is supporting the **FY27 Technology Modernisation agenda**, guiding the transition from legacy integration technologies towards strategic integration capabilities while balancing programme delivery, operational continuity and long-term technology sustainability.

  

What you'll do

* Define and maintain the integration architecture strategy, principles, standards and approved patterns for the TRANS4M programme.
* Translate enterprise architecture direction and business requirements into practical, implementable integration designs across SAP and non-SAP environments.
* Define current-state, transition-state and target-state integration architecture.
* Guide the migration from legacy integration technologies, including SAP PO, towards **SAP BTP Integration Suite** and target-state integration capabilities.
* Simplify the integration landscape by reducing unnecessary point-to-point integrations and increasing the use of reusable patterns and strategic capabilities.
* Act as the integration design authority across TRANS4M workstreams, reviewing and assuring solution designs, technical specifications and implementation approaches.
* Ensure architecture decisions appropriately consider security, scalability, resilience, recoverability, performance, supportability, cost and technology lifecycle.
* Identify architectural risks, security concerns, technical debt, unsupported technologies and design deviations, ensuring these are appropriately mitigated or governed.
* Maintain architecture decision records, standards, specifications, exceptions, interface inventories, dependency views and other governance artefacts.
* Provide architecture recommendations through relevant **Architecture Review Board, Change Advisory Board and programme governance forums**.
* Provide architecture leadership across concurrent workstreams and manage complex cross-platform and programme dependencies.
* Resolve complex integration design challenges and facilitate timely architecture decisions.
* Coordinate architecture dependencies across Enterprise Architecture, internal technology teams, Systems Integrators, delivery partners, vendors and third-party providers.
* Balance target-state architecture requirements with practical programme constraints while limiting avoidable technical debt and rework.
* Ensure security, data protection and technology-risk requirements are incorporated into integration solution designs.
* Assess solutions for operational readiness, including monitoring, error handling, supportability and recovery within the target operating environment.
* Support technology risk assessments and ensure architecture exceptions are documented, approved, time-bound and supported by remediation plans.
* Develop and maintain reference architectures and reusable patterns for **APIs, application integration, data integration, managed file transfer, event-driven integration and third-party connectivity**.
* Produce and assure architecture diagrams, solution specifications and governance submissions.
* Facilitate architecture workshops, technical design reviews and architecture decision sessions.
* Mentor architects, technical leads, integration engineers and delivery teams, building architecture capability and enabling teams to make routine decisions within established standards.
* Build alignment across programme leadership, Enterprise Architecture, SAP, integration, infrastructure, security and risk teams.
* Partner with Retail, Finance, Supply Chain and HR stakeholders to ensure architecture decisions support required business outcomes.
* Communicate architecture decisions, risks, dependencies and implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support technology lifecycle planning and the rationalisation or retirement of legacy integration components.
* Use lessons from testing, implementation and production to continuously improve integration architecture standards and future solution designs.
* Protect Shoprite’s architectural direction by ensuring delivery partners implement solutions in line with approved enterprise standards and patterns.

  

What you bring

* A relevant tertiary qualification in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Enterprise Architecture**, or a related discipline.
* Relevant enterprise, solution, integration or SAP architecture certification would be advantageous.
* Equivalent substantial architecture experience may be considered where supported by demonstrated capability.
* Extensive experience in enterprise, solution or integration architecture within large, complex technology environments.
* Significant experience designing and governing enterprise integration solutions across **SAP and non-SAP landscapes**.
* Experience with **SAP S/4HANA** and enterprise SAP integration environments.
* Practical experience with **SAP BTP Integration Suite, SAP PO, SAP Data Services, SAP SuccessFactors, APIs and managed file transfer solutions**.
* Experience defining architecture principles, integration standards, reference architectures and reusable design patterns.
* Experience conducting architecture assurance, solution design reviews and technical risk assessments.
* Experience supporting large-scale transformation programmes involving multiple concurrent workstreams and complex dependencies.
* Experience working with Systems Integrators, delivery partners, third-party providers and technology vendors.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical, programme and business stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Experience governing security, resilience, supportability and operational-readiness requirements.

**Technical expertise**

* SAP S/4HANA integration architecture.
* SAP BTP Integration Suite and cloud integration capabilities.
* SAP PO, SAP Data Services and SAP SuccessFactors integration.
* API architecture, API management and REST-based integration.
* Synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven integration patterns.
* Application-to-application, data and third-party integration.
* Managed File Transfer and secure data-exchange patterns.
* Integration security, authentication, authorisation and data-protection principles.
* Interface lifecycle management, monitoring, error handling and recoverability.
* Enterprise and solution architecture principles and methods.
* Architecture governance, Architecture Review Boards and architecture decision records.
* Target-state architecture, transition planning and technology lifecycle management.
* Non-functional requirements including scalability, availability, resilience, performance and supportability.
* Technology risk, security assurance, operational readiness and service transition.
* Architecture repositories, modelling and integration landscape documentation.

**Key competencies**

* **Strategic architecture thinking:** You can connect integration requirements to enterprise architecture, technology modernisation and long-term business transformation.
* **Systems thinking:** You understand dependencies across SAP, non-SAP, cloud, third-party and legacy environments and can anticipate downstream impacts.
* **Architecture judgement:** You can balance security, scalability, resilience, supportability, cost, delivery complexity and strategic alignment.
* **Governance and assurance:** You apply strong architecture discipline without unnecessarily slowing delivery.
* **Enterprise influence:** You can build credibility and alignment across architects, engineers, programme leaders, business stakeholders, partners and vendors.
* **Complexity management:** You bring structure and clarity to environments where multiple platforms, workstreams, stakeholders and dependencies intersect.
* **Pragmatic decision-making:** You protect target-state architecture while providing practical, delivery-focused guidance.
* **Communication and collaboration:** You can explain complex architecture decisions and risks clearly and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* **Coaching and knowledge transfer:** You build integration architecture capability through mentoring, standards and practical design guidance.
* **Accountability and integrity:** You take ownership of architecture decisions and risks through to closure and constructively challenge solutions that are non-compliant, unsustainable or introduce unacceptable risk.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**

Why Babble?

Babble is a Customer Experience-led growth business. As the ultimate Trusted Advisor for cloud-based technologies, we specialize in empowering businesses with the best solutions from the world's leading providers.

We are specialists in:

* Microsoft Modern Work
* Cybersecurity
* Contact Centre Technology
* Mobile Solutions
* Communications & Connectivity

With thousands of customers, we're just scratching the surface of our potential. Many of our clients currently benefit from one or two of our technologies, presenting an incredible opportunity to introduce them to our full suite of market-leading solutions.

Join us on this exciting journey and let's achieve greatness together!

About Us | Leading UK Cloud Solutions Provider | Babble

 **Job Description**

**Join Our Dynamic Team as a Solutions Architect!**

Do you enjoy building complex Microsoft Azure solutions, not just designing them? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment? At Babble, we’re on a mission to be our customers’ most trusted advisor for cloud-based technologies. We’re looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our dynamic team. If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

**Purpose of the Role**

The Solutions Architect is a senior, hands-on technical delivery resource and technical authority within the Babble Professional Services team. The primary focus of the role is the personal implementation, configuration and deployment of complex customer solutions, centred on Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure and extending across Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Networking and Backup/DR. Operating as a Level 3 Engineer, the role personally builds and deploys solutions on complex, high-risk and multi-domain projects and sets the technical standard for how solutions are built and configured across the team.

The role also owns the design phase of customer engagements, producing High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs and Statements of Work that translate requirements into buildable, production-ready solutions. Design and deployment are treated as a single continuum: the Solutions Architect is accountable for the technical quality of the solution from design through to a working, tested and handed-over deployment, and stays hands-on throughout.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Hands-on Technical Delivery**

* Lead hands-on implementation on complex, high-risk or multi-domain projects including Azure Virtual Desktop deployments, complex network architectures, multi-tenant security configurations, hybrid identity environments, and large-scale migration programmes.
* Personally build, configure and deploy Microsoft Azure environments, including landing zones aligned to the Cloud Adoption Framework, management group and subscription structures, Azure Policy, RBAC and cost governance.
* Implement Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies, VNet peering, Azure Firewall, NSGs, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints, Azure DNS and hybrid connectivity to on-premises and branch sites.
* Deploy and configure identity and access solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity (Entra Connect and Cloud Sync), Conditional Access and Privileged Identity Management.
* Deliver Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 deployments end to end, including host pools, image management, FSLogix profile storage, scaling and security baselines.
* Plan and execute server, workload and data migrations to Azure using Azure Migrate and related tooling, including cutover, rollback planning and post-migration optimisation.
* Implement Azure backup and disaster recovery using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery, including recovery testing against agreed RTO and RPO.
* Configure security and monitoring across Azure and Microsoft 365, including Defender for Cloud, Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
* Automate deployment and configuration using PowerShell, Azure CLI and Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM and/or Terraform), and build reusable deployment templates for the team.
* Deploy and configure the wider Babble portfolio hands-on, including Microsoft 365 and Intune, Sophos Firewall and Sophos Central, Mimecast, and Acronis Cyber Protect.
* Act as the final technical escalation point during delivery, diagnosing and resolving complex configuration, integration and environment issues directly.

**Design, Assurance and Team Leadership**

* Produce High-Level Designs and Low-Level Designs for customer solutions across Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Network and Backup/DR domains, defining the technical architecture, configuration specifications, integration requirements, and dependencies that form the basis of all Professional Services delivery.
* Author Statements of Work that clearly define project scope, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones, ensuring commercial and technical alignment between what has been sold and what will be delivered.
* Provide technical guidance and design assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle, reviewing implementation progress against HLD/LLD specifications, validating configuration decisions made by fellow engineers and advising on deviations from the approved design where necessary.
* Act as a senior technical resource for the wider Professional Services team, providing guidance on design ambiguities, environment conflicts, vendor-specific technical issues, and scope boundary questions to support effective project delivery across all levels.
* Support pre-sales technical activities including customer scoping calls, solution qualification, technical feasibility assessments, and design input for proposals, ensuring opportunities are technically sound and deliverable before commitment to Statement of Work.
* Conduct technical design reviews with customers to validate requirements, confirm design assumptions, identify risks, and secure sign-off on the proposed solution architecture before delivery commences.
* Define and maintain technical standards, deployment checklists, configuration baselines, and design templates used across the Professional Services team, ensuring consistency and quality across all project deliveries.
* Validate UAT results and technical acceptance for projects where the Solutions Architect has produced the design, confirming that the delivered solution meets the specifications defined in the HLD/LLD and Statement of Work.
* Mentor and develop Level 1 and Level 2 engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, knowledge sharing and structured feedback, actively supporting career progression and capability uplift within the Professional Services team.
* Collaborate with the Support Desk, NOC, Product Managers, and Solution Leads to ensure solutions are designed for operational supportability, including monitoring requirements, escalation paths, documentation standards, and ongoing managed service compatibility.
* Identify and communicate project risks, design constraints and technical dependencies to Project Managers, the Solutions Delivery Manager and customers, providing clear recommendations and mitigation options to support informed decision-making.
* Lead post-implementation design reviews on complex projects, evaluating design effectiveness against delivery outcomes, capturing lessons learned and feeding improvements back into design standards and templates.
* Maintain expert-level technical skills and advanced vendor certifications across the Babble solution portfolio, attending vendor technical briefings, evaluating new product capabilities, advising on the evolution of the portfolio and staying current with platform roadmaps, architectural best practices and emerging technologies across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Mimecast, Sophos, Acronis and networking.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Extensive experience of solution design and delivery across all four domains (Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Backup/DR and Networking) and Azure.
* Demonstrable design authorship (High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs and Statements of Work) and pre-sales technical experience.
* Track record of mentoring and raising the technical capability of a delivery team.

**Desired Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
* Sophos Certified Architect for Sophos Firewall and Sophos Central Endpoint/Server (each requires the corresponding Sophos Certified Engineer certification as a prerequisite).
* Acronis Certified Engineer (Cyber Protect).
* Mimecast Certified Product Professional, Advanced level (Email Security, Cloud Gateway).

**Advantageous Certifications**

* PRINCE2 7th Edition Practitioner, or equivalent project management certification (for example PMP or APM PMQ).
* ITIL 4 Foundation (or ITIL Version 5 Foundation) in IT service management.
* CISSP (ISC2), or equivalent senior security certification; CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) is an acceptable foundational alternative.
* CrowdStrike Falcon certifications such as CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) or Falcon Responder (CCFR), and familiarity with the Falcon Complete managed detection and response service.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why work for Babble?**

* Risk cover; covering Life Cover, Critical Illness Cover, funeral benefits and some Disability benefits
* 22 days holiday Balance PLUS UK Bank Holidays - with increased annual leave based on length of service
* 5% allowance based on basic salary that can be towards Medical Aid.
* UPS provided to assist with load shedding (2-4hrs power for a laptop)
* Babble issued laptop
* Annual Company Celebrations

**Home-Working Policy**

* Your location will be home based, and you will require stable internet connection.
* It will be your responsibility to have a solution in place to mitigate loadshedding to ensure you are able to work your normal shifts effectively, working from a public space is not deemed a acceptable solution.
* As a home worker we expect you to have a suitable work set up, desk and a chair in a quiet space.

**The recruitment journey**

We want to fill this role quickly, but we want to get the right person. The recruitment process will consist of a screening call. If you proceed past this then you will have an interview over Teams and possibly a follow up interview and competency testing depending on the role requirements.

Direct Candidates Only

title: QA Lead
description:
**Who we are:**
===============

Mama Money is a growth-stage fintech on a mission to improve the financial lives of migrants and underserved communities across Africa and beyond. What started in 2015 as a cross-border payments service has grown into a multi-product financial platform, giving people the tools to send, save, and manage money on their own terms, at a socially fair price. Payments were just the beginning; today Mama Money is building the fuller financial toolkit our customers need, all under one roof.

Mama HQ is in beautiful Cape Town. We're 173 people strong (and counting), representing 19 countries across Africa, Asia, the UK, and Europe. Everything we build is in service of people who deserve better, and our culture reflects that same commitment. We've had good times and tough times, but the focus never shifts: people over profit, always.

### **The role, in short;**

As QA Lead, you’ll own quality across our product and engineering function, right at the heart of how we build and ship. You’ll set our QA strategy and be accountable for the quality of everything we ship. If a bug reaches production, you own understanding why and making sure it doesn’t happen again. Engineers still own the quality of their code. It’s hands-on leadership, balancing big-picture ownership with genuine day-to-day involvement.

Three strengths will define how you do it:

* Analytical mind: You’ll build a deep understanding of our product and tech ecosystem, and think critically about where our QA strategy goes next and how our processes add value.
* Technical aptitude: You’ll build and maintain our test automation platforms, drive adoption of new QA tools, and design test scenarios and validation strategies grounded in how our systems work.
* Mentorship mindset: You’ll communicate the QA vision at Mama Money to QA engineers and developers, and help our team-based QA engineers understand the systems context behind their work so they write effective test cases.

### **What you'll actually be doing:**

* Define and drive the overall QA strategy across product and engineering
* Build, mentor, and lead a team of QA engineers, setting priorities and reviewing their work
* Design and implement manual and automated testing frameworks across web, mobile, and API layers
* Own test planning for new features and releases, ensuring adequate coverage before go-live
* Own large release readiness, with authority to make the go/no-go call on quality grounds
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and DevOps to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle
* Identify, triage, and track defects, working with engineering to prioritise fixes
* Lead root cause analysis on production bugs and drive fixes to process, coverage, or tooling
* Establish and monitor QA metrics (production bugs, resolution time, test coverage, release quality) and report to stakeholders
* Own the production bug rate as your primary measure of success
* Continuously improve testing processes, tooling, and best practices as the team and product scale
* Ensure compliance and regulatory requirements are reflected in test coverage, where relevant to fintech operations

### **What we’re looking for:**

* 6+ years' proven experience as a QA professional within an Agile software development environment including experience in a QA Lead, Senior QA Engineer, or similar quality-focused leadership role
* Experience leading or managing QA engineers, setting priorities and developing their skills
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Demonstrable experience setting QA strategy for a team or product, as well as writing test cases
* A track record of owning release quality and reducing production bugs
* Strong background in both manual and automated testing (e.g. Selenium, Cypress, Postman, or similar tools)
* Experience with mobile test automation (e.g. Appium, Detox, or similar)
* Extensive experience testing back-end systems through a variety of methods (REST, SQS, database, and front-end interfaces), plus experience testing web and mobile applications
* Strong SQL skills, with familiarity in relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench
* Proficiency with Git or other version control systems
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); familiarity with AWS services such as EKS, RDS, SQS, and API Gateway is a plus
* Hands-on experience with API tools such as Swagger, Bruno, and Postman
* Experience writing and updating scripts using JavaScript
* Skilled in exploratory testing, with a sharp eye for bugs and UX issues
* Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to trace and report bugs clearly and efficiently
* Nice to have: fintech or payments experience, and performance or load testing experience

description:

========================

Job Requisition ID: 7646

Cape Town, ZA

**About the Role**

The Reliability Engineer leads and executes Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety (RAMS) engineering activities across products and systems. The role ensures that products meet reliability targets and safety requirements through reliability modelling, hazard identification, risk assessment and compliance with applicable industry standards, supporting safe, dependable and certifiable system performance throughout the product lifecycle.

  

**Qualifications and experience:**

* Minimum BEng or BSc in Electronic or Mechatronic Engineering, or a similar university qualification.
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in a Reliability and Safety Engineering environment.
  

**Key technical skills:**

* Knowledge of reliability modelling, prediction methodologies (MIL-HDBK-217) and statistical analysis.
* Expertise in hazard identification, safety risk assessment and mitigation planning.
* Understanding of the Systems Engineering Process in accordance with ISO/IEC 15288.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and test reports.
* Ability to conduct safety analyses and develop safety plans, safety reports and other safety documentation, including overall hazard log management.
* Safety case development in accordance with standards such as DEF STAN 00-056, MIL-STD-882 and IEC 61508.
* Knowledge of Radar, Datalinks and related technology domains will be advantageous.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Enterprise Resource Planning systems, particularly SAP ERP.
* Proficiency in Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety (RAMS) tools such as ASCE, Cradle, Medini Analyze, Relex and Relyence.
* Strong analytical, modelling and data interpretation skills.
  

**Key responsibilities:**

**Safety Engineering, Hazard Analysis and Safety Case**

Lead system safety activities through hazard identification, risk assessments, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOP), Hazard Identification (HAZID) and safety risk classification, while developing and maintaining safety cases and hazard logs to ensure effective safety risk management and compliance with applicable safety standards.

  

**Reliability Engineering and Modelling**

Develop reliability predictions, models and analyses for products and systems, including Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) calculations, reliability allocation, Reliability Block Diagrams (RBDs) and failure rate estimations to provide engineering teams with reliable technical inputs that improve system robustness and performance.

  

**RAMS Integration with Design and Verification**

Collaborate with systems engineering teams to integrate reliability and safety requirements into product design and qualification activities, defining RAMS metrics, acceptance criteria and safety compliance evidence to support effective verification, validation and achievement of system performance requirements.

  

**Compliance, Standards, Assurance and Continuous Improvement**

Monitor and verify RAMS engineering activities against applicable industry standards, customer requirements and organisational procedures through audits, reviews and technical investigations to maintain compliance and continuously improve reliability and safety engineering practices, tools and methodologies.

  

**Technical Risk Management and Failure Investigation**

Identify and manage technical risks, failure modes and safety concerns throughout the design and development lifecycle, supporting failure investigations, root cause analyses and corrective actions to minimise system risks and enhance product reliability, safety and operational performance.

description:

##### **Position summary**

##### **About our company**

Clicks Group

##### **Introduction**

Introduction The Integration Services Portfolio Manager is responsible for the strategic direction, tactical planning, operational performance, governance, reliability and continuous evolution of the organisation's Integration Services portfolio. The portfolio includes enterprise service bus services, API gateways, messaging platforms, backend APIs and microservices, container and Kubernetes environments, and the emerging Site Reliability Engineering capability. The role leads multiple technical teams and remains accountable for the availability, security, performance, supportability and lifecycle of the platforms and services they manage. It drives the transition from legacy ESB-centric integration toward API-led, event-driven and cloud-native architectures while ensuring that current production services remain stable and fit for purpose. Job Purpose To lead and manage the Integration Services portfolio, ensuring the effective delivery, operation, governance, reliability, modernisation and continuous improvement of enterprise integration capabilities. The role aligns portfolio investment and delivery priorities with business strategy, enterprise architecture, security requirements and operational needs, while building the people, engineering practices and reliability capabilities required for sustainable service delivery.

##### **Job description**

**Portfolio Scope**
===================

* Enterprise Service Bus services and middleware platforms.

* API gateway and API management platforms.

* Enterprise messaging and event-streaming platforms.

* Backend APIs and microservices.

* Container and Kubernetes application environments.

* Site Reliability Engineering and production reliability practices.

* DevOps pipelines, release enablement and deployment automation.

* Observability, production support and service stability.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Integration Strategy and Portfolio Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with EA to define Integration Services strategy, investment priorities, and multi-year roadmap.

* Define the operating model, engineering standards, and standard operating practices of the technical teams in the portfolio.

* Establish roadmaps for ESB modernisation, API management, messaging, event-driven architecture, microservices, containers, Kubernetes, DevOps, observability and Site Reliability Engineering.

* Translate enterprise architecture direction and business priorities into an executable portfolio of platform, service and capability initiatives.

* Prioritise portfolio demand, capacity and investment across operational obligations, strategic change, technical debt and lifecycle requirements.

* Develop business cases and investment proposals for platform renewal, capability uplift, resilience and modernisation.

* Monitor technology and industry trends and assess their relevance to the integration portfolio.

* Define portfolio performance measures and provide transparent reporting on delivery, operational health, risk, cost and roadmap progress.

**Operational Accountability**
------------------------------

* Own operational accountability for all platforms and services managed by the Integration Services teams.

* Ensure that services achieve agreed availability, reliability, performance, security, recovery and supportability objectives.

* Ensure appropriate service ownership, support models, escalation paths, operational documentation and on-call arrangements are established.

* Provide leadership and accountability during major incidents affecting integration services and business operations.

* Ensure incidents and recurring problems are investigated through effective root-cause analysis and followed by sustainable corrective actions.

* Oversee capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, vulnerability remediation, patching, upgrades and technology lifecycle management.

* Maintain visibility of operational risk, aged technical debt, single points of failure, unsupported technologies and service continuity concerns.

* Balance production stability with the need for change, modernisation and faster delivery.

**Integration Platform, API and Messaging Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------

* Oversee the team responsible for ESB services and its evolution toward API gateway, API management, messaging and event-streaming capabilities.

* Establish and govern API, integration and messaging standards, patterns, reusable services and platform guardrails.

* Drive adoption of API-first, contract-first and event-driven approaches where appropriate.

* Ensure integration services are reusable, discoverable, secure, observable, supportable and aligned with enterprise architecture.

* Guide platform selection, product evaluation, upgrades, rationalisation and decommissioning decisions.

* Ensure effective management of interface dependencies, service contracts, versioning and backward compatibility.

**Backend Services and Microservices Leadership**
-------------------------------------------------

* Oversee the team responsible for API and microservices development in containerised and Kubernetes environments.

* Ensure consistent engineering practices for backend service design, development, testing, security, deployment and support.

* Promote architectural consistency, appropriate service boundaries and effective management of distributed-system complexity.

* Ensure non-functional requirements such as resilience, scalability, performance, observability and recoverability are built into services.

* Support the Technical Lead in maintaining team capability, delivery quality, development standards and succession readiness.

* Drive modernisation toward maintainable, loosely coupled and cloud-native service architectures.

* Improve the overall engineering maturity of the teams inside the portfolio and influence the maturity across the systems being integrated.

**Site Reliability Engineering Capability**
-------------------------------------------

* Establish and mature the Site Reliability Engineering capability, including its mandate, operating model, roles, practices and measures.

* Build and lead a team of Site Reliability Engineers responsible for reliability engineering, DevOps enablement, observability and production stability.

* Define and embed Service Level Indicators, Service Level Objectives and error-budget practices for critical services.

* Establish reliability, resilience, capacity, incident, problem and operational-readiness practices across the portfolio.

* Promote automation of repetitive operational work and reduce avoidable manual support effort.

* Introduce production-readiness reviews and ensure that new or materially changed services are supportable before release.

* Use service performance and incident data to identify systemic reliability improvements and prioritise engineering work.

**DevOps, Observability and Production Enablement**
---------------------------------------------------

* Oversee the maturity, security and reliability of CI/CD pipelines supporting Integration Services.

* Ensure appropriate controls for source management, build, test, security scanning, deployment, configuration, rollback and release traceability.

* Establish observability standards across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts and correlation identifiers.

* Ensure teams have usable operational insights into service health, transaction flow, dependency failures and customer or business impact.

* Drive automation, self-service and platform-engineering practices that improve delivery speed without weakening risk and control requirements.

* Ensure production support is integrated with engineering teams and that operational learning informs backlog and roadmap priorities.

**Architecture, Governance and Risk Management**
------------------------------------------------

* Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, solution architecture, security, data, engineering and service-management standards.

* Participate in architecture governance forums and ensure significant integration decisions receive appropriate review.

* Own and maintain portfolio-level technical risks, exceptions, dependencies and mitigation plans.

* Ensure security-by-design and privacy-by-design principles are applied to APIs, messaging, platforms and services.

* Establish fit-for-purpose governance that provides control and consistency without creating unnecessary delivery friction.

* Ensure architecture decisions, platform standards and lifecycle positions are documented and communicated.

**Leadership and People Management**
------------------------------------

* Lead multiple technical teams and first-line managers or Technical Leads across Integration Platforms, Backend Services and Site Reliability Engineering.

* Define the organisation structure, role accountabilities, workforce plan and capability requirements for the portfolio.

* Set objectives, conduct performance and talent reviews, and hold subordinate leaders accountable for effective people management.

* Oversee succession planning, career paths, capability development, recruitment, onboarding and retention.

* Ensure leave, capacity, team coverage and workforce risks are managed effectively through the leadership structure.

* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, engineering excellence, operational ownership, learning and continuous improvement.

* Mentor Technical Leads and senior specialists and build a sustainable leadership pipeline.

* Address material performance, conduct or employee-relations matters in partnership with Human Resources and senior leadership.

**Financial, Commercial and Vendor Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Prepare and manage portfolio budget inputs, forecasts, licensing requirements and investment plans.

* Monitor platform, cloud, infrastructure, support and vendor costs and identify opportunities for optimisation.

* Manage strategic vendor and service-provider relationships, performance, risks and escalation.

* Participate in product selection, commercial evaluation, contract negotiation, renewal and exit planning.

* Ensure that commercial commitments, licensing models and support arrangements remain aligned with portfolio strategy and operational needs.

**Stakeholder Engagement**
--------------------------

* Build trusted relationships with Enterprise Architecture, IT Executives, Application Portfolio Managers, Security, Infrastructure, Data and Analytics, PMO and business stakeholders.

* Act as the senior point of accountability for Integration Services performance, priorities, risks and strategic direction.

* Provide executive and governance reporting on portfolio health, operational stability, investment needs and roadmap progress.

* Influence technology and delivery decisions that affect integration, APIs, messaging, microservices and production reliability.

* Facilitate cross-team resolution of priorities, dependencies, service ownership and operational concerns.

##### **Minimum requirements**

**Minimum Requirements**
========================

**Job Related Knowledge**
-------------------------

* Integration architecture, enterprise integration patterns, service-oriented architecture and API-led integration.

* API gateways, API management, RESTful services, service contracts, versioning and lifecycle governance.

* Enterprise messaging, event-driven architecture, publish-subscribe patterns and event-streaming concepts.

* Microservices architecture, distributed systems, resilience patterns and backend engineering practices.

* Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, container security and cloud-native platform concepts.

* Site Reliability Engineering principles, Service Level Indicators, Service Level Objectives, error budgets and toil reduction.

* DevOps operating models, CI/CD, release management, infrastructure as code and DevSecOps controls.

* Observability, including logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards and application performance monitoring.

* Incident, problem, change, capacity, availability, continuity and disaster-recovery management.

* Enterprise and solution architecture governance, technology standards, security architecture and risk management.

* Portfolio management, strategic roadmapping, demand prioritisation, investment planning and benefits tracking.

* People leadership through subordinate managers or Technical Leads, workforce planning and organisational capability development.

* Financial management, vendor management, commercial evaluation and software licensing concepts.

**Job Experience**
------------------

* 12 or more years of Information Technology experience.

* 10 or more years of relevant experience in application integration, middleware, API management, backend engineering, platform engineering or related disciplines.

* At least 5 years of leadership experience managing senior technical teams, Technical Leads or managers.

* Experience establishing or materially maturing DevOps, observability, production support or Site Reliability Engineering capabilities.

* Experience leading major incidents, addressing recurring operational problems and managing technology risk.

* Experience with budget planning, vendors, contracts, licensing or managed-service providers.

**Education**

-------------

**Preferred**
-------------

* Postgraduate qualification in Technology Management, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.

* Relevant certification in enterprise or solution architecture, cloud architecture, Kubernetes, IT service management, Agile delivery or Site Reliability Engineering.

**Job Related Competencies**
============================

**Strategic and Portfolio Competencies**
----------------------------------------

* Technology strategy and roadmapping

* Portfolio and investment management

* Business alignment and value orientation

* Innovation and modernisation leadership

* Risk-based prioritisation

* Technology lifecycle management

**Operational Competencies**
----------------------------

* Service reliability and operational accountability

* Major incident leadership

**Technical Competencies**
--------------------------

* Messaging and event-driven architecture

**About the company**

**Utopia** is an ultra-luxury hospitality and lifestyle brand creating a global ecosystem of properties and experiences.

We develop private villa retreats in beautiful locations around the world, each with high-end service. **Utopia** also offers a wider ecosystem of leisure experiences and services available both to those staying on property and to external visitors.

**Utopia** designs and builds its properties in-house. Our projects span the full journey: from concept and architecture to construction, interiors, landscape, guest experience, and long-term operation. For architects and designers, this means contributing on properties from the ground up, with the ability to influence how each place is planned, built, and experienced. For hospitality professionals, it means collaborating with a brand where service is personal, attentive, and built around each guest’s stay.

We’re a young, ambitious team with high standards and a hands-on approach. We value strong ideas, practical thinking, attention to detail, and people who are ready to take ownership of their part of each project. You will research local requirements, translate them into clear technical tasks for project teams, coordinate AORs and local consultants, and drive approval processes through to completion.

This role requires independent problem-solving, strong execution skills and the ability to establish effective processes in a fast-moving international environment.

* Experience managing local AORs, consultants and government authorities.

* Strong ownership, analytical thinking and process-building capabilities.
* Fluent English

* Spanish and/or Portuguese.
* Hands-on permitting experience in Spain, Brazil, Latin America, the UAE, or South Africa.
* Background in luxury residential or hospitality development.

* **Properties across three continents.** You'll take projects through approval in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Latin America, so you won't be limited to one market, one regulator, or one type of permit.
* **A team that spans 30+ countries.** Developers, architects, engineers, and legal specialists from every corner of the world, held to the same standards and the same bar for quality.
