title: PC&L Trainee/Intern
description:
**Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader**
----------------------------------------------------

We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.

**Your mission, roles and responsibilities**
--------------------------------------------

**Main Purpose of The Role**

The **PC&L Graduate** supports the Production Control and Logistics team in ensuring the efficient flow of materials, components and finished goods throughout the plant. The role provides practical exposure to material planning, inventory control, production scheduling, supplier coordination, customer requirements and logistics processes, while developing the graduate for future responsibilities within supply chain and logistics.

  

As a **PC&L Graduate**, your main responsibilities are as follow but not limited to:

**Production & Material Planning**

* Assist with production planning based on customer requirements and plant capacity.
* Monitor material availability to support uninterrupted production.
* Identify potential material shortages and escalate risks promptly.
* Assist with monitoring supplier deliveries against production requirements.
* Support changes to production schedules where required.

**Inventory & Stock Control**

* Monitor stock levels for raw materials, components and finished goods.
* Assist with cycle counts and physical stock counts.
* Investigate stock discrepancies and support corrective actions.
* Support initiatives to reduce excess and obsolete inventory.
* Help maintain accurate system and physical inventory records.

**Logistics & Material Flow**

* Support the movement of material from receiving through production to dispatch.
* Assist in resolving material-flow and logistics issues.
* Monitor deliveries and collections.
* Support packaging, warehousing and transport activities.
* Participate in continuous-improvement activities relating to material flow.

**Supplier & Customer Support**

* Follow up with suppliers regarding outstanding or delayed deliveries.
* Assist with communication of material requirements and delivery priorities.
* Support the team in responding to customer delivery requirements.
* Escalate supply or delivery risks that could affect production or customers.

**Reporting & Systems**

* Prepare and maintain PC&L reports and trackers.
* Update relevant planning, inventory and logistics information.
* Analyse basic logistics and inventory data to identify trends or abnormalities.
* Assist with monitoring PC&L KPIs.
* Maintain accurate documentation and records.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in improvement projects within PC&L.
* Support waste reduction, stock accuracy and material-flow improvement initiatives.
* Assist with root-cause analysis of shortages, stock discrepancies and delivery issues.
* Support standardisation and implementation of PC&L processes.

**Your profile and competencies to succeed**
--------------------------------------------

* **Qualification/s**

* + Bachelor’s Degree, Diploma or Advanced Diploma in either, Supply Chain Management/ Logistics Management/ Operations Management/ Industrial Engineering

* **Knowledge & Experience**

* + Advanced numerical skills
  + Strong Microsoft office skills and reporting skills
  + SAP basics or knowledge is a advantage
  + Business international mindset
  + Attention to detail and accuracy
  + Knowledge of productivity / lean management methodology
  + Knowledge of production, quality management and logistics
  + Languages: Ability to speak, write and read the English language

**What we can do for you**
--------------------------

* At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
* We are the seventh-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
* We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.

**Why join us**
---------------

FORVIA, a global automotive technology supplier, comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA.

With over 137 500 people, including more than 12,000 R&D engineers across 40+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow. Composed of 6 business groups and a strong IP portfolio of over 12,400 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMs worldwide.

In 2025, the Group achieved a consolidated revenue of 26.2 billion euros prior to IFRS 5. FORVIA SE is listed on the Euronext Paris market under the FRVIA mnemonic code and is a component of the SBF 120 index.

FORVIA aims to be a change maker committed to foreseeing and making the mobility transformation happen. www.forvia.com

title: Head of Security
description:
* **Who we’re looking for:** An experienced security leader who is as comfortable reviewing pen test results and SIEM output as briefing the board. You’ll have led the response to a major cyber incident and built security in a scaling, data-sensitive business, ideally in fintech or payments, and you can turn complex risks into clear, practical priorities.
* **The challenge:** Tillo is growing as a group, and our security needs to keep up. You’ll set and lead a group-wide security strategy, raising standards across our platforms, our cloud and our acquired businesses, and you’ll lead the response if a serious security incident happens
* **Where you’ll work:** This role will be based in Cape Town office 3 days per week, you’ll be part of our global team, collaborating with colleagues and serving customers across the UK, USA, Australia, South Africa, Italy and beyond.

**The Tillo Difference**

We're in the business of rewards and incentives, so we know a thing or two about the importance of giving back. We can't grow as a business without growing as individuals, so we are committed to providing a workplace where passionate, driven individuals can thrive. We value collaboration, trust, positivity, and a willingness to learn - only by working as a team will we reach our goals.

We’re the market leader in the UK and are active in a number of other markets including USA, Europe, Australia and India.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Security Strategy & Risk Management**

* Develop and implement a group-wide information security strategy and roadmap.
* Assess current vulnerabilities, prioritise risks and establish clear ownership of remediation.
* Own the security risk framework and risk appetite, and be accountable for the risk register (maintained by the Information Security Manager), reporting framework and control environment.
* Embed security by design across software development, infrastructure, cloud services and business Systems. Working with Engineering, define and roll out proportionate security gates across the group’s development lifecycle: threat modelling for significant changes at design stage, automated code, dependency and secrets scanning in CI.
* Establish proportionate security policies, standards and controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

### **Security Incident Response, Business Continuity and Recovery**

* Act as incident lead for significant security incidents, directing investigation, containment, remediation and recovery.
* Ensure root-cause analysis is completed and lessons learned are translated into practical security improvements.
* Own the incident response plan, escalation protocols and crisis management procedures. Technical response is led by the Security Engineer; the incident log, root-cause analysis and corrective actions are tracked by the Information Security Manager.
* Own business continuity and disaster recovery plans for critical services, including regular testing against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.
* Coordinate with internal technology teams, external incident response specialists, forensic investigators, legal advisers and relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure appropriate evidence preservation, incident documentation and timely escalation of material risks.
* Work with legal and privacy specialists to assess notification obligations to regulators, customers and other affected parties.

### **Technical Security and Infrastructure**

* Own identity and privileged access risk, working with the IT Manager, whose team operates the identity platforms, to improve privileged access, authentication and access reviews.
* Strengthen cloud, network, endpoint, application and infrastructure security.
* Improve vulnerability management, patching, penetration testing and security monitoring.
* Evaluate and implement appropriate detection, logging, alerting and response capabilities.
* Oversee supplier security risk, with assessments carried out by the Information Security Manager, and review integrations, APIs and other potential attack surfaces.
* Work with engineering and IT teams to improve secure development practices and operational resilience.
* Own the security of the group’s customer facing platforms against abuse, including bot activity, scraping, credential stuffing and API misuse. Set and maintain controls such as WAF rules, rate limiting and bot management, and work with Product and Platform, who own fraud rules and fraud losses, through an agreed handoff for detection, escalation and response.
* Own the security standards for customer and partner access to group platforms, working with Engineering, who build and run them. This includes API key and token issuing, rotation and revocation, IP allowlisting for API buyers, and role based access and permissions in customer facing tools such as the Management Hub.

### **Governance, risk and compliance**

* Be accountable for the group ISMS and relevant security frameworks, such as ISO 27001, NIS2 and Cyber Essentials Plus, and applicable payment security requirements, including extending certification scope to acquired businesses.
* Oversee customer security assessments, due diligence, audits and contractual security commitments, providing senior sign-off and escalation.
* Oversee the security awareness programme across the group.
* Work closely with Legal, Risk/Compliance, Engineering, IT and commercial teams.
* Ensure data protection and privacy requirements are addressed in partnership with relevant specialists.

### **Strategy and leadership**

* Set and maintain the information security strategy and roadmap, aligned to business goals and risk appetite.
* Lead and develop the security team, hire to build out capability, and manage the security budget.
* Own the group's security vendor relationships, such as CrowdStrike and Cloudflare, and managed detection and response, penetration testing and incident response partners. This includes evaluating and selecting new vendors, commercial negotiation and renewals, and holding vendors to agreed service levels.
* Own security reporting on posture, risks and incidents to the executive team, Cyber Committee and board.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Essential**

* Significant experience in information security, cybersecurity or security engineering, ideally in a senior Security Lead, Head of Security or equivalent role.
* Proven experience leading or coordinating the response to a major security breach or cyber incident, including containment, recovery, investigation and remediation.
* Strong technical understanding of modern cloud-based technology environments, SaaS platforms, APIs, identity management and enterprise infrastructure.
* Experience building or materially improving security controls in a scaling technology, fintech, payments or other data-sensitive business.
* Ability to assess complex technical risks and translate them into clear business priorities.
* Experience working with executive teams and communicating security risks confidently to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrable experience implementing security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Hands on application and API security experience, such as secure code review, threat modelling and the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10, with the credibility to challenge engineering teams on design and code
* A pragmatic, hands-on approach, with the credibility to challenge technical teams and drive urgent change.

### **Desirable**

* Experience in fintech, payments, financial services or other environments with high customer and data security requirements.
* Experience across multiple businesses, acquired companies or complex technology environments.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2, PCI DSS where applicable, GDPR and relevant regulatory expectations.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC or equivalent practical expertise.
* Experience managing specialist security vendors, penetration testers, managed detection and response providers, and incident response partners.

### **Personal Attributes**

* Calm and decisive under pressure, particularly during a live incident.
* Comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels.
* High personal ownership, urgency and a bias towards action.
* Able to influence without relying solely on formal authority.
* Commercially aware and capable of balancing risk, cost and delivery.
* Collaborative, credible and able to build trust across different businesses and technical teams.

**Benefits**

We offer all our employees trust and empower our team to work with flexibility and autonomy. We’re a close-knit team and love working collaboratively, with our hybrid model, our team can come together at our fantastic offices, but also focus in their own space. The Tillo team are a motivated bunch and we all work hard to push Tillo forwards, always innovating. We completely understand the importance of work/life balance and offer a supportive and collaborative working environment with the following benefits:

* 21 days holiday per annum (plus an additional day for your birthday )
* Retirement Fund (5%)
* Health insurance contribution
* Employee Incentive Scheme
* Hybrid Working
* Top spec equipment including laptop, mouse, keyboard, monitor
* Anniversary gifts
* Monthly breakfasts, drinks, snacks and events
* Team Learning & Development budget

**About Tillo**
---------------

Tillo makes gift cards, rewards, and incentives simple, efficient, and profitable. Operating in over 41 countries and 25 currencies, Tillo processes billions in gift card transactions through a single, plug-and-go API, powering rewards and incentives for the world’s leading businesses.  
  
Backed by Tenzing, Tillo is setting the global standard for digital gift card infrastructure.

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.*

title: Regional Security & AI Lead (EMEA)
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Cloudbox is the technology partner of choice for alternative investment managers and specialist financial firms. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hedge funds, asset managers and family offices across the UK, South Africa, Singapore and New York propel their businesses with the cloud, securely and in line with what their regulators expect.

Our clients now want to use AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot and Azure OpenAI, and they want a partner they trust to show them how to do it safely. That’s where you come in.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As our Regional Security & AI Lead, you’ll run our Security & AI department across EMEA. You’ll be the senior security owner in the SA/UK time zone, deputising for our US-based Global Head of Security & AI and leading advisory, security operations, security projects and AI for our clients in the region.

You’ll also be a trusted voice with client COOs, CCOs and fractional CTOs, complementing their work rather than competing with it.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

**Lead the Security & AI department in EMEA**

  

* **Advisory:** lead security-led advice to clients, including quarterly business reviews, events and thought leadership.
* **Security operations:** oversee our security support engineers, who respond to alerts and requests after first-line triage by our managed detection partner.
* **Security projects:** oversee the engineers who onboard new clients onto our security stack.
* **AI:** direct our AI team’s work for EMEA clients, along with our AI governance and AI services.
* Hire, lead and develop the people in each team, and coordinate cover with colleagues on the US shift.
* Set priorities, KPIs and reporting for each team, and grow the department as Cloudbox scales.
* Work closely with regional leadership and the heads of Engineering, Service Delivery, Client Success, Transitions & Projects and Automation.

  

**Set security strategy and standards**

* Set EMEA security and AI priorities with the Global Head, and report risk and performance to regional and group leadership.
* Own the security baseline for client Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune and Azure environments, and sign off changes that affect security through our change board.
* Provide independent security assurance over the platforms and tools our engineering teams run.
* Lead the security response to major incidents, working alongside our service delivery leads.
* Make sure vulnerability management, penetration testing and third-party risk reviews run on schedule, with remediation tracked to closure.

  

**Lead AI security and governance**

* Work closely with the Global Head of Security & AI on Cloudbox’s AI governance framework, and make sure it is applied across EMEA clients and teams.
* Advise clients on adopting Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI and similar tools safely, including data readiness, Purview labelling, DLP and permissions clean-up.
* Assess AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data leakage and over-permissive agents and connectors, and design controls against them.
* Turn AI readiness and AI security into services we offer clients, working with our Automation team so every request reaches the right solution.

  

**Keep us and our clients compliant**

* Map our services and client environments to the rules that apply in EMEA, including FCA SYSC and operational resilience, DORA, UK GDPR, POPIA and the EU AI Act.
* Lead or support our certifications and audits, such as ISO/IEC 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 42001.
* Prepare clear evidence and answers for client due diligence questionnaires (DDQs), investor queries and regulator requests.

  

**Be a trusted adviser to clients**

* Act as the senior security and AI adviser to client leadership, including in quarterly reviews and board-level briefings.
* Support pre-sales with security and AI expertise, proposals and RFP responses.
* Work with our account and client success colleagues to resolve escalations, and keep standards consistent across regions.
* Keep up with threats and regulatory change, and share what matters with clients through briefings, content and events.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* 10+ years in information security, with at least 4 leading several security functions or teams, ideally across more than one country.
* Experience building an operating model, managing a budget and setting KPIs for security teams.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft security (Entra ID, Intune, Defender XDR, Sentinel and Purview), enough to guide and challenge engineers.
* Practical experience securing AI tools in a business, such as Copilot rollouts, data access controls for LLMs or AI acceptable-use policies.
* Working knowledge of frameworks including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls and the NIST AI RMF.
* Experience with financial services regulation in the UK or EU, such as FCA rules, operational resilience or DORA.
* Incident response leadership, from first triage through to root cause and lessons learned.
* Clear writing and speaking for senior, non-technical audiences. You can explain a risk to a hedge fund COO in five minutes.
* Comfort working in a matrix organisation across time zones.
* The right to work in South Africa, and willingness to travel, including to London.

  

**NICE TO HAVES:**

* Experience at a managed service provider (MSP or MSSP), or in IT for hedge funds and asset managers.
* Familiarity with the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications.
* Knowledge of South African requirements such as POPIA and the FSCA and Prudential Authority joint cybersecurity standard.
* Experience with managed detection and response services, and scripting skills (PowerShell, KQL, Python).
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CCSP; Microsoft SC-100, SC-200 or AZ-500; IAPP AIGP; or ISO 27001 or 42001 Lead Implementer or Auditor.

  

**YOUR FIRST YEAR:**

* **First 3 months:** get to know the team, our clients and their environments, and agree a security risk roadmap with the Global Head.
* **By 6 months:** have KPIs and reporting in place for each team, and be rolling out Cloudbox’s AI governance framework and client AI readiness assessment across EMEA with the Global Head.
* **By 12 months:** raise baseline compliance across client environments, complete a clean audit cycle and have at least one AI security service live with clients.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

* A senior role shaping how financial firms in EMEA adopt AI safely, with real influence on our services.
* The chance to build and lead a growing department as Cloudbox scales.
* Work across three continents with a close-knit team that has served the alternative investment industry for over 20 years.
* A competitive salary and benefits package, with support for your professional development and certifications.

title: Senior Software Developer- FTC
description:
We are looking for a **Senior Software Developer** to join a new digital product team at one of our insurance clients, as a Saratoga consultant.

You'll lead the design and delivery of complex, high-impact software across the full software development lifecycle. You'll also help shape technical direction, build security in from the start and mentor the developers around you.

\*\* Please note: this is a hybrid contract role based in Cape Town's Northern Suburbs, with 3 days a week in the office. We'd love you to start as soon as possible, and no later than mid-January 2027.

**About the team and product**

The team is building a new, digitally distributed insurance product, sold through WhatsApp and the web. The first version is live. The next phase adds product variants, new features and new enrolment journeys.

The team sits inside a large insurer with its own governance, but works like a start-up: try things, learn fast and change what doesn't work. It starts lean and grows as the product proves itself. You will work closely with the product owner, who is hands-on, and with architects and engineers in neighbouring web, WhatsApp and platform teams.

**What you will do**

* Own the web sales journeys for the product, from front end to back end.
* Build and extend features in the product's back-end services.
* Design and build the integration layer that connects the web team, the WhatsApp/chatbot team and third-party services.
* Where a needed back-end service doesn't exist and its owning team has no capacity, build it with that team's architect, within their standards.
* Advise the team on technical options and light architecture decisions. Solution architects are available in other teams for the bigger calls.
* Use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, AWS Kiro) to deliver faster, and help the team set sensible guardrails for using them.
* Keep documentation current (specs, integration notes, decisions) so knowledge stays with the team.
* Conduct and approve code reviews, and enforce design principles and security guidelines.
* Champion test-driven development, with strong coverage across unit, integration and UAT testing.
* Build security in from the start, using OWASP Top 10 principles, threat modelling and secure coding practices.
* Design and optimise solutions on AWS or Azure, including infrastructure, security configuration and cost.
* Lead root-cause analysis on systemic issues and drive their resolution.
* Advise business stakeholders and senior management on technical options and trade-offs.
* Mentor and coach junior and intermediate developers.

**What we are looking for**

Must have

* Senior-level professional software development, comfortable working across front end, back end and integration.
* API and integration design and build, including third-party services.
* Node.js for API and integration services.
* Angular, or a similar modern front-end framework.
* Daily, effective use of AI coding tools, with the judgement to keep the software sound as it grows.

* 8 – 10+ years of commercial software development experience.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or equivalent.
* Advanced, hands-on experience with AWS or Azure in production environments.
* Strong API design, microservices and distributed systems experience.
* Experience applying security-by-design principles and OWASP guidelines in delivered solutions.
* Experience mentoring developers and engaging with senior stakeholders, up to Exco level.

Highly preferred

* Strong Java back-end development. The product's main back end is Java, so this counts for a lot, but strong engineers from other stacks who use AI tools well will be considered.
* Software architecture experience: designing services and integrations, and making sound technical decisions across teams.
* Advanced certifications, for example AWS Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer – Professional, Microsoft AZ-305 or AZ-400, or Certified Scrum Professional.

Nice to have

* Insurance, long-term savings or financial services experience.
* GitHub Copilot or AWS Kiro (spec-driven development) specifically.
* WhatsApp or conversational channel integrations.
* Python.
* Cloud platform experience.

* Security certifications, for example AWS Security Specialty or CompTIA Security+.
* TOGAF Foundation.
* Domain knowledge of premium collections, product, digital or actuarial systems.

title: Senior Product Manager - Payments (GTXN)
description:
### **About us:**

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. Since 2013, we've helped millions of people around the world buy, store and invest in crypto, working with regulators in every market and holding all customer crypto 1:1. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on  
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

### **About the team**

You will join the Product team building GTXN, Luno's global settlement business. GTXN focuses on institutional payments: the collections, pay-outs, virtual account and conversion products that let businesses and financial institutions move money in and out of emerging markets through one integration. You will work with dedicated engineering and UX partners to build and run the payment products that GTXN customers depend on.

GTXN has the ambition to operate like a startup so this role needs flexibility and a balance between systems thinking and speed: you will design for the long term and still ship quickly.

### **The role in a nutshell**

You will turn GTXN's strategy into the payments roadmap, work with Engineering and Payment Partnerships to build the money movement products customers run on, such as collections, pay-outs and virtual accounts, and make sure every payment is fast, reliable, affordable and controlled.

### **Your mission will be**

* **Own the GTXN payments roadmap:** Work closely with Commercial and business owners to turn the GTXN and business strategy into the payments roadmap. Lead discovery through to launch and adoption, enabling the payment flows customers need
* **Define what our rails and providers must deliver:** Set the product requirements for every new payment flow or corridor
* **Work closely with Payment Partnerships:** Lead the product and engineering input to provider selection, and keep the corridor backlog aligned with their provider pipeline
* **Launch new corridors and currencies:** Take new corridors from customer need to live product. Turn requirements into an integration scope that Engineering can build from without guesswork, and turn each launch into a playbook that makes the next one faster.
* **Drive product decisions with data:** Define the right measures for institutional payments, so you can see where they succeed, stall or cost too much, and decide what we build, fix and prioritise
* **Lead the cross-functional effort** to make payments reliable, operable and trusted. Define the product behind routing, reconciliation, failure handling and internal tooling, supporting Operations
* **Shorten the path from signed customer to first live payment**: Shape the customer implementation journey. Work hands-on with new customers to plan their integration, find where activation loses customers, and turn what you learn into repeatable integration capabilities.

### **A little about you**

* You are a senior Product Manager in payments, banking, a regulated fintech or a crypto business.
* You have built institutional or B2B money movement products, such as collections, pay-outs, account-to-account transfers or virtual accounts, including integrating with and managing banks or payment providers
* You understand how a payment works end to end: local and cross-border rails, settlement, reconciliation, returns and failures, and what each step costs
* You are technically comfortable where product meets integration: the transaction lifecycle, ledger and reconciliation basics, API integration design, bank and provider APIs, payment messaging, retries and failure handling, in enough depth to make good trade-offs with engineers
* You are rigorous with data: success rates, failure reasons, time to settle and cost per payment. You can find where a flow leaks, quantify what it costs, and prioritise accordingly
* You understand the commercials of payments: pricing, unit economics and how cost flows through to margin
* You write a clear integration scope, and you communicate precisely with the engineering partners you lead the work with
* You manage stakeholders as a craft: keeping payment operations, treasury, compliance, banks and customers aligned, communicating risks early
* You can balance speed with compliant, secure and trusted payments, and hold a position on customer experience when a control or regulatory requirement pulls the other way
* Experience with payments in emerging markets, in Africa or Southeast Asia, or with multi-currency, cross-border or stablecoin settlement is a strong advantage
* You use AI as part of how you work and can show where it has changed your output, not just your tooling. Exposure to AI-enabled back-office operations is a plus.

### **Life at Luno:**

* Remote but reachable work policy gives you the freedom to choose between working from home or the office.
* Plus the option to buy and sell up to 5 days leave
* Improve body and mind, with excellent private medical insurance
* Enjoy peace of mind with Luno's comprehensive retirement fund and essential risk benefits.

title: Workforce Management & Dialler Analyst
description:
This role is responsible for the day-to-day management and optimisation of dialler campaigns, ensuring maximum operational efficiency and performance across our collection’s environment.

The Workforce Management & Dialler Analyst is responsible for optimising workforce capacity, real-time operational performance and outbound dialler effectiveness within the Collections Department.

The role combines workforce planning, real-time analysis, dialler campaign management and performance analytics to ensure that operational resources are effectively utilised and aligned with business demand and collection objectives.

The successful candidate will work closely with Collections Management to ensure that the right number of agents are available at the right time, working the appropriate customer portfolios through effective contact strategies.

Through data analysis, performance monitoring and continuous optimisation, the role aims to improve agent productivity, contact rates, right-party contacts (RPC), campaign effectiveness and overall collections performance.

**Key Performance Areas and Responsibilities:**

**Workforce Management (WFM) & Capacity Planning**

* Analyse historical and current contact volumes, operational demand and staffing requirements.
* Support workforce forecasting and capacity planning to ensure adequate resource allocation.
* Monitor workforce availability against operational requirements throughout the day.
* Track and analyse schedule adherence, agent utilisation, occupancy, absenteeism and shrinkage.
* Identify staffing gaps, including overstaffing and understaffing, and recommend appropriate adjustments.
* Provide workforce insights and recommendations to support operational planning and productivity.

**Real-Time Management & Operational Performance**

* Monitor intraday operational performance against forecasts, staffing plans and established targets.
* Identify emerging backlogs, capacity constraints, operational bottlenecks and performance variances.
* Proactively communicate performance risks and recommend corrective action to Collections Management.
* Work with Team Managers and operational stakeholders to facilitate resource redeployment and workload prioritisation.
* Monitor agent availability, adherence and productivity throughout operational shifts.
* Prepare and distribute intraday, daily and weekly performance reports.
* Escalate operational deviations that may negatively impact productivity or collections performance.

**Dialler Management & Campaign Optimisation**

* Configure, schedule, monitor and optimise outbound dialler campaigns.
* Manage and optimise predictive, progressive, preview and power-dialling strategies.
* Monitor key dialler performance indicators, including:
* Right-Party Contact (RPC) rate.
* Contact and answer rates.
* Dialler penetration rates.
* Abandonment rates.
* Agent utilisation.
* Campaign conversion and collection outcomes.
* Optimise campaign pacing, data allocation, call prioritisation and customer segmentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer contactability and campaign effectiveness.
* Monitor campaign performance and implement adjustments based on operational requirements and analytical findings.
* Investigate and troubleshoot dialler performance issues in collaboration with Operations, IT and external service providers.
* Ensure campaign configurations and dialler strategies align with operational requirements and approved business rules.

**Data Analysis, Reporting & Business Intelligence**

* Extract, analyse and interpret large operational datasets to identify trends, patterns and performance opportunities.
* Utilise advanced Microsoft Excel to develop analytical reports, dashboards and performance models.
* Develop and maintain regular WFM, dialler and campaign performance dashboards.
* Analyse relationships between staffing levels, dialler strategies, customer contactability, agent productivity and collections results.
* Identify performance gaps and provide data-driven recommendations to improve operational efficiency.
* Ensure the accuracy, integrity and consistency of workforce and campaign reporting.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations to management in a clear and practical manner.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance measurement.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with the Head of Collections, Team Managers and Collections Operations to align workforce and dialler strategies with business objectives.
* Provide operational insights and recommendations to improve productivity and collections performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, reporting structures and campaign strategies.
* Collaborate with IT and external vendors to resolve technical and operational challenges.
* Remain informed of industry trends, workforce management practices and dialler optimisation techniques.

**Minimum Qualifications & Experience**:

* Matric / Grade 12 or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum of 2 years' relevant experience in one or more of the following:
* Workforce Management (WFM).
* Real-Time Analysis (RTA).
* Resource Planning.
* Dialler or Campaign Management.
* Contact Centre Operations Analytics.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to analyse large datasets and develop reporting tools.
* Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of contact centre performance metrics and operational KPIs.
* Experience monitoring operational performance and identifying deviations against targets.
* Ability to interpret data and translate findings into practical operational recommendations.
* Ability to make informed, time-sensitive decisions in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with operational management.
* Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

**Advantageous Qualifications & Experience**

The following will be considered a strong advantage:

* Previous experience within the debt collections or financial services industry.
* Experience managing and optimising outbound dialler campaigns.
* Practical knowledge of predictive, progressive, preview and power dialling.
* Experience with workforce forecasting, scheduling and capacity planning.
* Knowledge of SQL and database querying.
* Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence and visualisation tools.
* Previous experience within a BPO or high-volume contact centre environment.
* Relevant qualifications in Business Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, Operations Management or a related field.

**Package & Remuneration**

Working Hours

* Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

**What Prime Loans offers**

* Competitive basic salary: R30,000 – R45 000
* The opportunity to work in a **high-performance, data-driven collections environment.**
* Exposure to multiple collections portfolios and campaign optimisation strategies.
* A dynamic team focused on continuous improvement and growth.
* Medical insurance and provident fund benefits, paid 100 % by the company.

Pay: R30 000,00 - R45 000,00 per month

description:
We're looking for an **Intermediate Test Analyst** to join one of our financial services clients as a Saratoga contractor. You'll own test cycles end to end, bring automation into the team's day-to-day work, and be the link between business analysts and developers. Your job is to make sure what's built does what the business needs.

\*\* Please note: this is a hybrid contract role based in Cape Town's Northern Suburbs, with 3 days a week in the office. We'd love you to start as soon as possible, and no later than mid-January 2027.

**About the team and product**

The team builds and supports business-critical systems in a large, regulated financial services environment. Work is delivered in Agile sprints, and quality is everyone's job, with feedback loops and quality gates built into how the team delivers.

You'll work closely with business analysts, developers and product owners, and get to know the business area the team supports so that your testing focuses on what matters most.

**What you will do**

* Own the test cycle for your features or releases, from requirements review through to UAT sign-off.
* Review requirements, user stories and specs to find gaps early, and make sure acceptance criteria are testable before development starts.
* Design and maintain test plans, test cases and test scripts.
* Run functional, regression, integration and end-to-end tests.
* Build and maintain automated regression and smoke tests, and keep them running in the CI/CD pipeline.
* Set quality criteria at feature and sprint level to stop defects slipping through.
* Keep defects well documented, prioritised and moving towards resolution.
* Support developers with SIT and unit test coverage.
* Report clearly on quality at sprint and release level.
* Share your knowledge with junior testers and help improve the team's testing standards.

**What we are looking for**

Must have

* 4 – 7 years of IT or software testing experience.
* ISTQB Foundation Level (CTFL) certification.
* A degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or equivalent. A relevant diploma with enough experience will also be considered.
* Proven end-to-end ownership of test cycles in a commercial environment.
* Hands-on test automation experience with at least one framework, such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress or Robot Framework.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams alongside business analysts and developers.
* Strong test design skills, including black-box, boundary and experience-based techniques.

**Highly preferred**

* CI/CD pipeline integration for automated tests.
* API testing with tools such as Postman or REST Assured.
* A plan to work towards ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst (CTAL-TA) or Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA). The client expects this as your next career step.

**Nice to have**

* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* A test automation certification, for example in Selenium, Cypress or Playwright.
* Exposure to performance and non-functional testing.

**What to expect**

* Hybrid: currently 3 days a week in the client's Cape Town office, for design sessions and working alongside architects. Exact days can be agreed.
* Onboarding: starts as soon as you join, with access, induction and domain sessions, so you are productive quickly.
* Support from Saratoga: you'll be backed by Saratoga's senior technical and AI practice, with architect-level support available during the start-up phase.

**Who we are**

Get to know the team, the tech, and the impact we create at https://saratogasoftware.com

title: Entry Level Service Desk Analyst

As pioneers in the industry, we are driven by a relentless commitment to excellence.

**Position Overview**

As a member of the Service Desk Team, you will be the first point of contact for clients experiencing technical issues. You will diagnose problems quickly and accurately while performing standard, preliminary research. You will use a variety of remote access, user admin, and related tools.

  

At Frontline Managed Services, we understand that not everyone comes to us with a wealth of IT experience. That's why we provide industry-leading training to get you up to speed.

title: Technical Operations Lead / Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst / Technical Operations Lead**

**Location:** Stellenbosch, Western Cape  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Arrangement:** 4 days in-office  
**Experience Required:** 3–5 years

**Are you a technically minded problem-solver who enjoys working at the intersection of business, technology and people?**

Our client, a fast-growing technology company based in Stellenbosch, is looking for an ambitious and solutions-driven **Technical Operations Lead (Business Analyst)** to join their team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, enjoys working with clients and has a genuine passion for technology and business improvement.

This is not your typical Business Analyst or technical support position. You'll play an integral role in implementing technology solutions, managing client relationships, overseeing platform operations and contributing to ongoing product development.

You'll work closely with business leaders, clients and technical teams, taking ownership of projects from initial requirements gathering through to successful implementation and ongoing support.

If you're looking for a role where you can make a real impact, take on meaningful responsibility and accelerate your career within a growing technology business, this could be the opportunity for you.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

**Essential Requirements**

* **Education:** A relevant degree or diploma in Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Business Management with IT, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** 3–5 years' relevant experience in Business Analysis, Project Coordination, Technology Operations, Technical Client Success or a similar role.
* Strong business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process mapping and solution documentation.
* A solid understanding of technology platforms, systems and technical processes.
* Some coding knowledge or practical exposure to coding concepts, with the ability to engage confidently with developers.
* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to coordinate projects, manage competing priorities and drive tasks through to completion.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* A client-focused approach with the ability to build strong professional relationships.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a high level of accountability.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment.
* Willingness and ability to work from the Stellenbosch office four days per week.

**Advantageous Experience**

* Exposure to low-code development platforms.
* Experience with APIs, systems integrations and software configurations.
* Familiarity with software testing, UAT and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience using project management, support ticketing or development tools.
* Previous exposure to HR technology, payroll systems, FinTech or employee engagement platforms.
* Experience supporting software implementations or digital transformation projects.

**Skills & Personal Attributes**

**You will succeed in this role if you:**

* **Think analytically:** You enjoy understanding how systems and processes work, identifying problems and developing practical solutions.
* **Are technically curious:** You have a genuine interest in technology and enjoy learning about new platforms, tools and systems.
* **Take ownership:** You are proactive, accountable and committed to seeing tasks through to completion.
* **Communicate confidently:** You can translate complex technical information into clear, practical language for clients and colleagues.
* **Are highly organised:** You can manage multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines without losing sight of the details.
* **Are client-focused:** You enjoy building relationships, understanding business needs and delivering exceptional service.
* **Adapt quickly:** You are comfortable working in a growing business where priorities evolve and new challenges arise.
* **Have a continuous improvement mindset:** You naturally look for ways to make systems, processes and client experiences better.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Implementations & Project Coordination**

* Manage end-to-end client implementations, from initial discovery and requirements gathering through to configuration, testing, go-live and post-implementation support.
* Understand client business processes and translate their requirements into practical technology solutions.
* Coordinate technical activities, integrations and project dependencies across internal and external teams.
* Facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), identify issues and ensure successful resolution.
* Coordinate client onboarding, training and implementation documentation.
* Monitor project milestones, risks and deliverables to ensure successful implementation.

**Business Analysis & Solution Design**

* Analyse business processes, identify operational challenges and recommend practical improvements.
* Gather, document and translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Develop process flows, workflows, business rules and solution requirements.
* Work closely with technical teams to ensure solutions meet business and client needs.
* Identify opportunities to improve system functionality, operational efficiency and user experience.

**Technology Operations & Technical Support**

* Take ownership of day-to-day platform operations, including configurations, integrations and technical troubleshooting.
* Investigate technical issues, identify root causes and coordinate appropriate resolutions.
* Manage incidents, support requests and technical escalations.
* Work with development and technical teams to resolve system issues and maintain platform reliability.
* Support technology transitions, system enhancements and software releases.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients.
* Act as a key point of contact for operational and technical matters.
* Manage client queries, change requests and service-related concerns.
* Monitor client satisfaction, platform adoption and engagement.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve the client experience and deliver additional value.

**Product Development & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product and technology teams to identify and prioritise enhancements.
* Translate client feedback and operational challenges into actionable product requirements.
* Participate in product testing, pilot projects and release coordination.
* Recommend improvements to existing processes, systems and technology solutions.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of the company's technology offering.

**Operational Reporting & Documentation**

* Monitor implementation progress, operational performance, service levels and key performance indicators.
* Identify operational risks, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare progress updates and operational reports for management.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, process guides, client records and implementation resources.
* Develop structured processes and documentation to support efficient, scalable operations.

**Growth & Career Development**

This opportunity offers much more than a conventional Business Analyst position.

You'll gain valuable exposure to business operations, technology implementations, client management and product development, allowing you to build a broad and highly sought-after skill set.

Working closely with experienced business leaders and technical specialists, you'll have the opportunity to develop your expertise, contribute ideas and take on increasing responsibility as the business grows.

For someone who is ambitious, eager to learn and motivated by making a tangible impact, this role offers excellent scope for professional growth.

**Why Consider This Opportunity?**

* **Meaningful responsibility:** Take ownership of projects and initiatives that directly influence business and client success.
* **Exposure to innovative technology:** Work with evolving digital platforms and contribute to technology-driven solutions.
* **Career development:** Expand your technical, analytical, project management and client relationship skills.
* **Cross-functional experience:** Collaborate with business leaders, product specialists, developers and clients.
* **Opportunity to make an impact:** Contribute directly to product improvements, operational efficiencies and client satisfaction.
* **Dynamic environment:** Be part of a growing technology company where initiative, problem-solving and fresh ideas are valued.

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**

If you're a motivated Business Analyst or technically minded operations professional who enjoys solving problems, working with technology and making things happen, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today by submitting your updated CV & motivational introduction**

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Alacrity**, a division of Saratoga, is seeking an experienced, people-focused **Engineering Manager** to join the international team at our client, **Worldwide Chain Stores.** (This is a permanent role, hybrid with 1 day per week in the office, Cape Town preferred)

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead WCS's software engineering function, reporting to the Director of Research and Development. You will oversee the Senior Developers and Junior Architects, Intermediate and Junior Developers, the Testing Lead and the Release Manager. You will build and develop the team to deliver R&D, customer enhancements, new modules and technical supply chain solutions for customers across North America, the UK and Ireland, Australia and South Africa.

WCS is AI-first: all developers and testers use AI to generate their work, with human review before delivery. You will keep this consistent, safe and measurable. You will also lead the move to a pod structure supported by a Software Factory, and form monthly sprints with the Product Owner and Services, owning the engineering side of each sprint's revenue commitment.

Working closely with Services, you will engage customers throughout project delivery and coordinate teams across South Africa, India and the UK. As a growing SME, WCS offers a direct, visible impact on growth, performance and team engagement.

**The Person**

You are an experienced engineering leader, equally comfortable coaching a developer, running a sprint review and reviewing a technical design. You lead with accountability, set clear expectations and build engaged teams where people grow.

You are practical about AI, with disciplined human review of everything it generates. You are confident with customers, explaining plans and trade-offs and keeping your commitments. You help pods adopt new ways of working, measure what matters and spread knowledge, so that delivery never depends on one or two people.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.People Management & Talent Development

* Line manage the engineering team through regular one-to-ones, coaching and feedback.
* Own talent management: identify strengths, set stretch goals and create opportunities for each person to do their best work.
* Lead performance management, including goal setting, quarterly development discussions and Individual Development Plans (IDPs).
* Run talent reviews and succession planning, with clear progression paths from junior and intermediate developer to senior and architect roles.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and retention, and build an inclusive, high-performance culture aligned to WCS's values of Caring, Continuous Improvement and Empowerment.

2. Pod Structure & Software Factory

* Establish and lead the pod structure, giving each pod clear purpose, ownership and the right mix of development, testing and release skills.
* Review work allocated by the Software Factory so it moves through the product backlog in a steady, predictable flow.
* Form each monthly sprint with the Product Owner and Services, aligned to monthly revenue targets.
* Act as Scrum Master for one or more pods and remove blockers.
* Balance priorities across R&D, customer enhancements, new modules and supply chain solutions.

3. AI-First Engineering & Delivery

* Ensure every developer and tester works AI-first, with human review before delivery.
* Set and enforce human quality gates across specification, AI-generated code, automated testing, UAT and release.
* Review AI-generated code and designs for quality, security and architecture fit, and coach the team to do the same.
* Drive AI testing agents and specification generation, and enable the Testing Lead and testers to own their AI testing agents.
* Work with the Release Manager to ensure controlled, repeatable releases.

4. Technical & Delivery Leadership

* Own delivery outcomes so work is delivered on time, to quality and to customer expectations.
* Provide technical oversight of code quality and architecture, and guide the Junior Architects in their development.
* Balance feature delivery with technical debt and platform modernisation.
* Keep platforms reliable and scalable as customer volumes grow, and support production issues and escalations.

5. Customer Engagement & Project Delivery

* Work with Services to engage customers from scoping and planning through go-live and support.
* Join customer calls and workshops across North America, the UK and Ireland, Australia and South Africa to explain the technical approach, timelines and trade-offs.
* Build customer commitments into sprint planning and flag risks or scope changes early.
* Coordinate teams across South Africa, India and the UK so delivery is consistent.

6. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement

* Apply the WCS four-pillar KPI model (Productivity, Quality, Adoption and Financial) to engineering.
* Track sprint delivery against monthly revenue targets and report to the Director of R&D and the AI Strategy Committee.
* Reduce single-point-of-failure risk by spreading knowledge and ownership across pods.
* Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience in warehouse, logistics or supply chain software.
* A formal Scrum Master certification (e.g. PSM or CSM).
* Experience in an SME or scaling organisation, and exposure to high-availability or 24/7 operational systems.

**What you will bring:**

* 8+ years in professional software development, with proven experience managing and leading development teams.
* Experience leading teams of mixed seniority, including developers, architects, testers and release management.
* Hands-on experience as a Scrum Master or leading iterative delivery. Experience leading multiple teams or pods is an advantage.
* Experience delivering complex, enterprise or business-critical software, ideally with global customers or distributed teams.
* A strong technical background in modern software development (e.g. Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python), with a solid understanding of architecture, APIs, integrations and databases.
* Experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and modern deployment practices.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear view of how to run an AI-first team with human review and quality gates.
* Experience working with services or consulting teams on customer projects, and confidence engaging customers directly.
* Experience using data and KPIs to measure team performance and link delivery to revenue targets.

**What success looks like**

Within 12 months, you will have achieved:

* Pods and the Software Factory running well, each with clear ownership, a steady sprint cadence and predictable delivery.
* Monthly sprints formed with the Product Owner and Services, and delivered consistently against revenue targets.
* Every developer and tester working AI-first, with human quality gates at each stage of the pipeline.
* Testers owning their AI testing agents and consultants drafting first-pass specifications, with no single points of failure.
* Customers and Services confident in delivery dates, with engineering visible and responsive throughout project delivery.
* Measurable improvement across the four KPI pillars of Productivity, Quality, Adoption and Financial.
* An up-to-date Confluence knowledge base for each product and customer, actively used by the team.
* An engaged, growing team where everyone has an Individual Development Plan, succession plans are in place, and junior and intermediate developers have a clear path to progress.

**Who we are**

Alacrity, a division of Saratoga, acts as a South Africa based Employer of Record for its international clients. The successful applicant will be employed by Alacrity but will be fully integrated into and will have direct reporting links into WCS. Get to know to know who we are and what we do at www.alacrity.co.za

**What does Worldwide Chain Stores do?**

Worldwide Chain Stores delivers enterprise-grade software platforms for warehouse, order and asset management used by global retail and supply chain organisations. Their solutions are business-critical to client operations and deployed internationally, supporting tier-one customers across North America, the UK and Ireland, Australia and South Africa. WCS is part of the Volaris Group, a global acquirer of vertical market software businesses focused on long-term growth and operational excellence.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

### **Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer wanted to join our Enterprise Solutions team in South Africa**

Joining the Enterprise Solutions team in South Africa, you will act as a Senior Technical Consultant and Lead Developer delivering custom enterprise solutions across **Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email, Mobile, Ad Studio)**, **Salesforce Data Cloud**, and **Salesforce Personalization**.

In this client-facing role, you will bridge strategic business requirements and deep technical execution—authoring technical blueprints and solution designs, developing complex data schemas and APIs, and engineering hyper-personalized dynamic communications. You will instill client confidence through mature consulting acumen, rigorous architecture, and exceptional technical leadership.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership:** Lead technical discovery and scoping for custom client engagements; translate complex business goals into end-to-end technical blueprints, architecture specifications, and delivery proposals.
* **Dynamic Content & Custom Development:** Develop highly personalized emails, landing pages, and web applications using native scripting (**AMPscript**, **SSJS**), **HTML**, **CSS**, **jQuery**, and **XSLT**.
* **Data Engineering & Schema Design:** Architect relational data models, Data Extensions, and automated extraction/ingestion workflows using advanced **SQL** queries and data mapping strategies.
* **Integrations & API Development:** Design and implement REST/SOAP web services, real-time API integrations, and secure data pipelines incorporating encryption protocols (PGP/GPG).
* **Cross-Cloud & Personalization Strategy:** Build and optimize end-to-end customer journeys and real-time interaction rules leveraging **Salesforce Data Cloud** (CDP) and **Salesforce Personalization**.
* **Client Engagement & Advisory:** Serve as the primary technical authority in client-facing discussions, leading workshops, explaining complex architecture to decision-makers, and aligning solutions with industry best practices.

### **Requirements**

* **Experience:** Extensive hands-on development and consulting experience within the **Salesforce Marketing Cloud** ecosystem on complex, enterprise-level digital marketing implementations.
* **Core Salesforce Tech Stack:**
* **Salesforce Marketing Cloud:** Email Studio, Mobile Studio (SMS/Push), Ad Studio, Automation Studio, Journey Builder.
* **Next-Gen Salesforce Platforms:** Salesforce Data Cloud and Salesforce Personalization (formerly Interaction Studio).
* **Scripting Languages:** Advanced **AMPscript**, Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS), and XSLT.
* **Development & Integration Skills:**
* **Data & Queries:** Advanced SQL for complex segmentation, relational database management (MSSQL, MySQL), and data mapping.
* **Web & Email Development:** Responsive HTML/CSS for email rendering standards, XML, and JavaScript/jQuery for interactive web pages.
* **APIs & Security:** REST/SOAP API programming and data encryption methods (PGP/GPG).
* **Programming Exposure:** Familiarity with modern programming languages (.NET, Java, PHP) is advantageous.
* **Functional Marketing Domain Expertise:**
* Deep understanding of Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), real-time personalization engines, and CRM data models across the entire customer lifecycle.

The Enterprise Architect holds end-to-end architecture accountability for an assigned portfolio or business domain and partners with business and technology leaders to align architecture with strategy, investment priorities and enterprise outcomes.

Translate business strategy and investment roadmaps into target architectures, capability maps, architecture runway and transition plans that engineering and delivery teams can implement. Guide architecture across business capabilities, applications, integration, data and technology.

Lead the simplification, modernisation and integration of the assigned technology landscape. Identify duplication and technical debt, define pragmatic transition paths and ensure designs address applicable security, resilience, data-protection and regulatory requirements.

Act as the architecture authority within the assigned portfolio or domain, providing decision-ready options, trade-offs, costs and risk positions. Apply enterprise architecture standards and governance practices, propose domain-specific extensions and escalate cross-domain decisions through the appropriate architecture forums.

  

What you'll do

**Architecture strategy and target state**
------------------------------------------

* Define and own the target architecture for the assigned portfolio or domain, aligned to enterprise strategy, business priorities and technology direction.
* Translate multi-year business and technology roadmaps into architecture blueprints, capability maps and transition states, and keep them current as priorities change.

**Portfolio: Fintech Platforms**
================================

**Portfolio scope and architecture partnership**
------------------------------------------------

Hold overall architecture accountability for Payments, Banking, Money Market Account (MMA), Money Market Payments (MMP) and future financial-services capabilities. Act as architecture partner to the Head of Fintech Platforms and the General Manager Financial Services.

**Portfolio-specific accountabilities**
---------------------------------------

* Translate the Fintech portfolio strategy and investment roadmap into a target architecture, architecture runway and transition plan for S-Tech Engineering & Platforms.
* Lead the architecture for consolidating MMA and MMP into a unified Money Market platform, including shared customer identity, account and ledger services, payment flows, channels and data. Remove duplication and define migration, coexistence and decommissioning paths that protect customers, balances and transactions.
* Architect payment capabilities across card, EFT, real-time payments, QR and wallet, cash-in/cash-out at till and remittances. Design for high-volume, low-latency, always-on processing, including month-end, Black Friday and festive trading.
* Architect secure integration with partner and sponsor banks, processors and payment schemes, and govern integration across SAP and non-SAP systems, the retail estate, loyalty and partner platforms.
* Ensure designs address applicable POPIA, PCI DSS, FICA and AML requirements, payment scheme rules, and Prudential Authority and FSCA standards on IT governance and cyber resilience. Architect fraud, AML and transaction-monitoring capabilities with Risk and Compliance.
* Define customer and transaction data architecture, lineage, consent and preference management, and regulatory reporting. Architect AI-enabled fraud detection, credit decisioning, personalisation and conversational service with appropriate model governance, explainability and bias controls.
* Define which AI models and third-party AI services are sanctioned within Fintech, working within S-Tech enterprise standards and governance practices.
* Act as architecture authority in portfolio governance chaired by the Head of Fintech Platforms. Provide options, trade-offs, TCO and risk positions; apply enterprise standards owned by S-Tech Head: Engineering & Platforms and propose domain-specific extensions.

* **Preferred:** Production AI/ML architecture or governance experience in financial services, such as fraud, credit or personalisation.
* **Preferred:** Retail-embedded financial-services experience, including in-store money services or retailer-led banking partnerships.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

**PURPOSE OF JOB**

To administer and continuously improve the Salesforce CRM platform for the Business Development & Marketing (BD&M) Digital team, ensuring that configuration, data integrity, user support and training, and reporting effectively meet the needs of Sales and BD&M stakeholders. The role combines Salesforce CRM administration with project delivery support and serves as a key operational link between BD&M, the Group Salesforce Architect, and external technology partners.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

**Salesforce Configuration, Administration**

* Maintain and support configuration primarily for Sales Cloud and related APIs within BD&M, including automations, flows and UI improvements. Occasional support on Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot) and Financial Services Cloud.

* Maintain and evolve BD&M-specific objects, fields, processes and functionality.

* Maintain documentation, manuals, in-app guidance, best practice notes, rules of engagement, SOPs and process playbooks for Sales Cloud and related applications.

**Data Integrity**

* Drive data integrity across BD&M-related Salesforce objects by running continuous data health checks and working with the operational teams to remediate identified issues where applicable.

* Monitor data quality trends across Salesforce and identify recurring issues requiring process, training or configuration improvements.
* Assist with data cleansing, migration and remediation activities.
* Ensure system usage aligns with agreed business processes and controls.

**Project Support**

* Supporting technical scoping, feasibility assessment, requirements gathering and change management for Digital team projects.

* Support delivery of technical projects involving Salesforce configuration, data cleanses and platform enhancements, from requirements through implementation.
* Maintain project documentation, timelines and risk logs, and support user acceptance testing and training for new features.

* Contribute to the team’s wider roadmap planning by providing input on Salesforce, CRM and MarTech priorities across relevant divisions.

**User Support, Training & Adoption**

* Deliver new user and standard Salesforce training, and identify training needs arising from break/fix or discovery work.

* Develop and deliver a training curriculum, increasing adoption and best-practice behaviours.
* Support adoption of new CRM and API features, ensuring smooth rollout of enhancements to BD&M users.
* Provide first-line support for applications within the Salesforce ecosystem, including but not limited to ZoomInfo, Introhive, Business Card Scanner and PandaDoc, and act as backup owner where required.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with the Group Salesforce Lead on platform planning, governance and change management practices.

* Liaise with external technology partners to scope and manage enhancement requests.

* Participate in cross-functional forums and represent BD&M Salesforce requirements in group-level planning.

**General**

* Adhere to the JTC core values and Guiding Principles.

* Any other duties as deemed necessary by Management.

**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Proven experience administering Salesforce (Sales Cloud) in a CRM or GTM operations environment
* Holding Salesforce Administrator Certification and/or related Salesforce certifications.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot) experience desirable but not essential.
* Familiarity with the wider Salesforce ecosystem and integrated marketing/sales technology applications.
* Experience supporting Salesforce users and providing training.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-starter, capable of working independently and collaboratively within a team.
* Comfortable operating across both technical and business audiences.

**OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION & WELLBEING**

JTC is committed to fostering a healthy, inclusive organisation where all individuals feel welcome and feel able to participate in the workplace fully. We value different perspectives, backgrounds and lived experiences. This includes supporting employee wellbeing so that people feel equipped to thrive.
